name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.ac_terminal_eq_neg_primitive
type:
∀ {L : ℝ} (g : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)) {f : ℝ → ℂ},
  AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval f 0 L →
    f L = 0 →
      (∀ᵐ (t : ℝ), t ∈ Set.uIcc 0 L → HasDerivAt f (↑↑↑g t) t) →
        ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc 0 L, f t = -Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.terminalPrimitive L g t

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedCurrent
type: (L : ℝ) → ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaCurrentDomain L) →ₗ[ℂ] ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedCurrent_apply
type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (u : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaCurrentDomain L)),
  (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedCurrent L) u =
    (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeCurrent L (1 / 2)) ↑u + (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaCurrent L) u -
        (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L (1 / 2)) ↑u -
      (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L (-(1 / 2))) ↑u

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedFrame_mem_currentDomain

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completed_polar_derivative
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},

    Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.polarDerivative L (1 / 2) * Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaOperator L (1 / 2) *
        Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeOperator L (1 / 2) =
      Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedFrame L (1 / 2) *
        (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L (1 / 2) + Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L (-(1 / 2)))

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedFrame_half
type:

  0 < L →
    Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedFrame L (1 / 2) =

        (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L (1 / 2) *
          (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.polarOperator L (1 / 2) *
            Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeOperator L (1 / 2)))

type: ∀ {L : ℝ}, 0 < L → Function.Injective ⇑(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedFrame L (1 / 2))

type:

type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N) (hx : (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpoint N L) x = 0),

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedSourceGram
type: (L : ℝ) → ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L) → ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L) → ℝ → ℂ

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.hasDerivAt_completedSourceGram
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (u v : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
      HasDerivAt (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedSourceGram L u v)
        (inner ℂ ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedFrame L (1 / 2)) u)
            ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedDerivative L) v) +
          inner ℂ ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedDerivative L) u)
            ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedFrame L (1 / 2)) v))
        (1 / 2)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedSourceGram_half
type:
∀ {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (w z : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.generatorDomain L)),
  Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedSourceGram L ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedSource L hL) w)
      ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedSource L hL) z) (1 / 2) =
    inner ℂ ↑w ↑z

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.hasDerivAt_completedColumnGram
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι] {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (U : ι → ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
      HasDerivAt (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedColumnGram L U)
        (fun i j =>
          inner ℂ ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedFrame L (1 / 2)) (U i))
              ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedDerivative L) (U j)) +
            inner ℂ ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedDerivative L) (U i))
              ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedFrame L (1 / 2)) (U j)))
        (1 / 2)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedSourceGram_half
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (x y : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N) (hx : (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpoint N L) x = 0)
  (hy : (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpoint N L) y = 0),
  Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedSourceGram L (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedSource hL x hx)
      (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedSource hL y hy) (1 / 2) =
    inner ℂ x y

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.hasDerivAt_completedSourceGram_current
type:
∀ {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (u v : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
  HasDerivAt (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedSourceGram L u v)
    (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedCurrentForm L
      ⟨(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedFrame L (1 / 2)) u, ⋯⟩
      ⟨(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedFrame L (1 / 2)) v, ⋯⟩)
    (1 / 2)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.hasDerivAt_completedColumnGram_current
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι] {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (U : ι → ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
  HasDerivAt (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedColumnGram L U)
    (fun i j =>
      Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedCurrentForm L
        ⟨(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedFrame L (1 / 2)) (U i), ⋯⟩
        ⟨(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedFrame L (1 / 2)) (U j), ⋯⟩)
    (1 / 2)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.hasDerivAt_literalSourceGram
type:
∀ {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (w z : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.generatorDomain L)),
  HasDerivAt
    (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedSourceGram L ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedSource L hL) w)
      ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedSource L hL) z))
    (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedCurrentForm L ⟨↑w, ⋯⟩ ⟨↑z, ⋯⟩) (1 / 2)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.hasDerivAt_nativeCompletedSourceGram_current
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (x y : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N) (hx : (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpoint N L) x = 0)
  (hy : (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpoint N L) y = 0),
  HasDerivAt
    (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedSourceGram L (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedSource hL x hx)
      (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedSource hL y hy))
    (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedCurrentForm L
      ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCurrentInclusion N hL) x)
      ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCurrentInclusion N hL) y))
    (1 / 2)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.HasGenerator
type: (L : ℝ) → ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L) → ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L) → Prop

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.HasGenerator.orbit_right
type:
∀ {L : ℝ} {f g : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)},
  Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.HasGenerator L f g →
    ∀ {t : ℝ},
      0 ≤ t →
        HasDerivWithinAt (fun y => (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift L y) f)
          ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift L t) g) (Set.Ici t) t

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.HasGenerator.orbit_integral
type:
∀ {L : ℝ} {f g : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)},
  Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.HasGenerator L f g →
    ∀ {t : ℝ},
      0 ≤ t →
        ∫ (y : ℝ) in 0..t, (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift L y) g = (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift L t) f - f

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.HasGenerator.eq_neg_volterra_zero
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 ≤ L →
    ∀ {f g : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)},
      Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.HasGenerator L f g → f = -(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L 0) g

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.hasGenerator_volterra
type:
∀ (L : ℝ),
  0 ≤ L →
    ∀ (b : ℂ) (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
      Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.HasGenerator L ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L b) f)
        (b • (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L b) f - f)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.hasGenerator_iff_eq_neg_volterra_zero
type:
∀ (L : ℝ),
  0 ≤ L →
    ∀ (f g : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
      Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.HasGenerator L f g ↔ f = -(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L 0) g

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.HasGenerator.unique
type:
∀ {L : ℝ} {f g g' : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)},
  Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.HasGenerator L f g → Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.HasGenerator L f g' → g = g'

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.HasGenerator.volterra_inverse
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 ≤ L →
    ∀ {f g : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)},
      Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.HasGenerator L f g →
        ∀ (b : ℂ), (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L b) (b • f - g) = f

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra_resolvent_identity
type:
∀ (L : ℝ),
  0 ≤ L →
    ∀ (b c : ℂ),
      Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L b - Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L c =
        (c - b) • Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L b ∘SL Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L c

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra_commute
type:
∀ (L : ℝ),
  0 ≤ L →
    ∀ (b c : ℂ),
      Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L b ∘SL Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L c =
        Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L c ∘SL Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L b

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra_injective
type: ∀ (L : ℝ), 0 ≤ L → ∀ (b : ℂ), Function.Injective ⇑(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L b)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeGammaConstant
type: ℝ → ℝ

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.tanh_half_exp
type: ∀ (L : ℝ), Real.tanh (L / 2) = (1 - Real.exp (-L)) / (1 + Real.exp (-L))

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaConstant_sub_native
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaConstant L - Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeGammaConstant L / 2 =
      Real.log (1 + Real.exp (-L)) - Real.log 2

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.hasDerivAt_log_logistic
type: ∀ (y : ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun y => Real.log (1 + Real.exp (-y))) (-(Real.exp y + 1)⁻¹) y

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.integral_logistic
type: ∀ {L : ℝ}, 0 ≤ L → ∫ (y : ℝ) in 0..L, (Real.exp y + 1)⁻¹ = Real.log 2 - Real.log (1 + Real.exp (-L))

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gamma_background_cancellation
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaConstant L - Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeGammaConstant L / 2 +
        ∫ (y : ℝ) in 0..L, (Real.exp y + 1)⁻¹ =
      0

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeGammaIntegrand
type: (L : ℝ) → ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L) → ℝ → ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gamma_logistic_difference
type: ∀ {y : ℝ}, 0 < y → (Real.exp y - Real.exp (-y))⁻¹ - Real.exp (-2 * y) / (1 - Real.exp (-2 * y)) = (Real.exp y + 1)⁻¹

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeGammaIntegrand_eq
type:
∀ {L y : ℝ},
  0 < y →
    ∀ (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
      Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeGammaIntegrand L f y =
        Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaIntegrand L f y - ↑(Real.exp y + 1)⁻¹ • f

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.integrable_logistic_current
type:
∀ {L : ℝ} (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
  MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => ↑(Real.exp y + 1)⁻¹ • f) (Set.Ioo 0 L) MeasureTheory.volume

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeGammaIntegrand_integrable
type:
∀ {L : ℝ} (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaCurrentDomain L)),
  MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeGammaIntegrand L ↑f) (Set.Ioo 0 L)
    MeasureTheory.volume

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaCurrent_native_formula
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaCurrentDomain L)),
      (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaCurrent L) f =
        ↑(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeGammaConstant L / 2) • ↑f +
          ∫ (y : ℝ) in Set.Ioo 0 L, Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeGammaIntegrand L (↑f) y

type:

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.generatorDomain_le_gammaCurrentDomain
type: ∀ {L : ℝ}, 0 < L → Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.generatorDomain L ≤ Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaCurrentDomain L

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaTruncated_zero
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 ≤ L →
    ∀ (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaCurrentDomain L)),
      Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaTruncated L 0 ↑f = (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaCurrent L) f

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaTruncated_tendsto
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaCurrentDomain L)),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun δ => Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaTruncated L δ ↑f) (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Icc 0 L))
        (nhds ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaCurrent L) f))

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaIntegrand_eq
type:
∀ (L y : ℝ) (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
  Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaIntegrand L f y =
    (↑(1 - Real.exp (-2 * y)))⁻¹ •
      (↑(Real.exp (-y / 2)) • (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift L y) f - ↑(Real.exp (-2 * y)) • f)

type: ℝ → ℝ → ℂ

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaPositiveKernel_neg
type: ∀ {L δ y : ℝ}, 0 < δ → y < 0 → Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaPositiveKernel L δ y = 0

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gamma_kernel_product
type:
∀ {L δ t : ℝ},
  0 < δ →
    t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 L →
      ∀ (y : ℝ),
        Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaPositiveKernel L δ y *
            Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaResolventKernel L (t - y) =
          (Set.Ioo δ t).indicator (fun y => ↑(Real.exp (-t / 2) / (1 - Real.exp (-2 * y)))) y

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gamma_kernel_convolution
type:
∀ {L δ t : ℝ},
  0 < δ →
    t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 L →
      ∫ (y : ℝ),
          Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaPositiveKernel L δ y *
            Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaResolventKernel L (t - y) =
        ↑(Real.exp (-t / 2) *
            if δ < t then
              Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.logPrimitive t - Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.logPrimitive δ
            else 0)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaIntegrand_split
type:
∀ (L y : ℝ) (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
  Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaIntegrand L f y =
    ↑(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaWeight y) • (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift L y) f -
      ↑(Real.exp (-2 * y) / (1 - Real.exp (-2 * y))) • f

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.continuousOn_gammaWeight
type: ∀ {δ L : ℝ}, 0 < δ → ContinuousOn Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaWeight (Set.Icc δ L)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaTruncated_eq
type:
∀ {L δ : ℝ},
  0 < δ →
    δ ≤ L →
      ∀ (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
        Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaTruncated L δ f =
          ↑(Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.currentConstant + Real.log (1 - Real.exp (-2 * δ)) / 2) • f +
            ∫ (y : ℝ) in δ..L,
              ↑(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaWeight y) • (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift L y) f

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.integral_gammaResolventKernel
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 ≤ L →
    ∀ (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
      ∫ (y : ℝ), Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaResolventKernel L y • (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift L y) f =
        (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L (1 / 2)) f

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.integral_gammaPositiveKernel
type:
∀ {L δ : ℝ},
  δ ≤ L →
    ∀ (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
      ∫ (y : ℝ), Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaPositiveKernel L δ y • (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift L y) f =
        ∫ (y : ℝ) in δ..L, ↑(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaWeight y) • (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift L y) f

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gamma_convolution_integrable
type:
∀ {L δ : ℝ},
  0 < δ →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (fun t =>
        ∫ (y : ℝ),
          Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaPositiveKernel L δ y *
            Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaResolventKernel L (t - y))
      MeasureTheory.volume

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaTruncated_volterra
type:
∀ {L δ : ℝ},
  0 < δ →
    δ ≤ L →
      ∀ (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
        Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaTruncated L δ ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L (1 / 2)) f) =
          ∫ (t : ℝ) in Set.Ioo 0 L,
            ↑(Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.cutoffCurrentKernel δ t) • (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift L t) f

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.integrableOn_real_kernel_shift
type:
∀ {L : ℝ} {k : ℝ → ℝ},
  MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn k (Set.Ioo 0 L) MeasureTheory.volume →
    ∀ (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => ↑(k y) • (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift L y) f) (Set.Ioo 0 L)
        MeasureTheory.volume

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.norm_real_kernel_shift_le
type:
∀ {L : ℝ} {k : ℝ → ℝ},
  MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn k (Set.Ioo 0 L) MeasureTheory.volume →
    ∀ (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
      ‖∫ (y : ℝ) in Set.Ioo 0 L, ↑(k y) • (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift L y) f‖ ≤
        (∫ (y : ℝ) in Set.Ioo 0 L, ‖k y‖) * ‖f‖

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gamma_cutoff_action_tendsto
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun δ =>
          ∫ (y : ℝ) in Set.Ioo 0 L,
            ↑(Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.cutoffCurrentKernel δ y) • (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift L y) f)
        (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioo 0 L))
        (nhds
          (∫ (y : ℝ) in Set.Ioo 0 L,
            ↑(Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.limitingCurrentKernel y) • (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift L y) f))

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gamma_limiting_action
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
      (2 * ↑Real.pi) •
          ∫ (y : ℝ) in Set.Ioo 0 L,
            ↑(Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.limitingCurrentKernel y) • (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift L y) f =
        -(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaDerivative L) f

∀ {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),

      (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaCurrent L) ⟨(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L (1 / 2)) f, ⋯⟩ =
    -(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaDerivative L) f

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaOperator_apply
type:
∀ {L σ : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    σ ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 →
      ∀ (u : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
        (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaOperator L σ) u =
          ∫ (y : ℝ) in Set.Ioo 0 L,
            ↑(Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.kernel σ y) • (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift L y) u

    ∀ (u : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
      (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaDerivative L) u =

type:
∀ {L : ℝ},

    ∀ (u : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
      (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaOperator L (1 / 2)) u =
        (2 * ↑Real.pi) • ∫ (y : ℝ) in Set.Ioo 0 L, ↑(Real.exp (-y / 2)) • (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift L y) u

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaOperator_half
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaOperator L (1 / 2) =

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift_volterra_commute

∀ (L : ℝ),
  0 ≤ L →
    ∀ (b : ℂ) {h : ℝ},
      0 ≤ h →
        Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift L h ∘SL Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L b =
          Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L b ∘SL Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift L h

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.orbitIntegral_eq_volterra_zero
type:
∀ (L : ℝ),
  0 ≤ L →
    ∀ (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)) {h : ℝ},
      0 ≤ h →
        ∫ (y : ℝ) in 0..h, (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift L y) f =
          (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L 0) (f - (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift L h) f)

type: ∀ (L : ℝ), 0 ≤ L → Dense ↑(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.generatorDomain L)

type:
∀ (L : ℝ) {k : ℝ → ℂ},
  MeasureTheory.Integrable k MeasureTheory.volume →
    ∀ (u : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => k y • (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift L y) u) MeasureTheory.volume

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.integral_shift_comp
type:
∀ {L : ℝ} {k l : ℝ → ℂ},
  MeasureTheory.Integrable k MeasureTheory.volume →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable l MeasureTheory.volume →
      MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable k →
        MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable l →
          (∀ y < 0, k y = 0) →
            (∀ y < 0, l y = 0) →
              ∀ (u : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
                ∫ (y : ℝ),
                    k y •
                      (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift L y)
                        (∫ (z : ℝ), l z • (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift L z) u) =
                  ∫ (t : ℝ), (∫ (y : ℝ), k y * l (t - y)) • (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift L t) u

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.killedShift_agrees_algebraic_ae
type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (y : NNReal) (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
  ∀ᵐ (t : ℝ),
    ∀ (ht : t ∈ Set.Ico 0 L),
      ↑↑↑((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.killedShift L y) f) t =
        (Riemann.Arithmetic.killedShift L y) (fun u => ↑↑↑f ↑u) ⟨t, ht⟩

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.cut_add

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.literalSourceColumns_apply
type:
∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] {N : ℕ}

  (hW : ∀ (x : F), (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpoint N L) (W x) = 0) (x : F),
  (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.literalSourceColumns hL W hW) x =
    Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedSource hL (W x) ⋯

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.frame_literalSourceColumns
type:
∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] {N : ℕ}

  (hW : ∀ (x : F), (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpoint N L) (W x) = 0) (x : F),
  (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedFrame L (1 / 2))
      ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.literalSourceColumns hL W hW) x) =
    Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierHilbert L (W x)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.literalColumnMetric
type:

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.literalColumnMetric_inner
type:
∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] {N : ℕ}
  {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (W : F →L[ℂ] Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N)
  (hW : ∀ (x : F), (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpoint N L) (W x) = 0) (σ : ℝ) (x y : F),
  inner ℂ x ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.literalColumnMetric hL W hW σ) y) =
    Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedSourceGram L ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.literalSourceColumns hL W hW) x)
      ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.literalSourceColumns hL W hW) y) σ

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.literalColumnMetric_half
type:
∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] {N : ℕ}
  {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (W : F →L[ℂ] Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N)
  (hW : ∀ (x : F), (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpoint N L) (W x) = 0),
  Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.literalColumnMetric hL W hW (1 / 2) = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint W ∘SL W

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.hasDerivAt_literalColumnMetric_inner
type:
∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] {N : ℕ}
  {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (W : F →L[ℂ] Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N)
  (hW : ∀ (x : F), (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpoint N L) (W x) = 0) (x y : F),
  HasDerivAt (fun σ => inner ℂ x ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.literalColumnMetric hL W hW σ) y))
    (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedCurrentForm L
      ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCurrentInclusion N hL) (W x))
      ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCurrentInclusion N hL) (W y)))
    (1 / 2)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.native_endpointCorrectedColumns_zero
type:
∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] {N : ℕ}
  {L : ℝ} (D : F →L[ℂ] Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N) (p : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpoint N L) p = 1 →
    ∀ (x : F),
      (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpoint N L)
          ((Riemann.Capacity.endpointCorrectedColumns D (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpointVector N L) p) x) =
        0

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.literalColumnMatrix
type:
{F : Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup F] →
    [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] →
      [FiniteDimensional ℂ F] →
        {N : ℕ} →

              0 < L →
                (W : F →L[ℂ] Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N) →
                  (∀ (x : F), (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpoint N L) (W x) = 0) → (ι → F) → ℝ → Matrix ι ι ℂ

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.hasDerivAt_literalColumnMatrix
type:
∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] {N : ℕ}
  {L : ℝ} {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype ι] (hL : 0 < L) (W : F →L[ℂ] Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N)
  (hW : ∀ (x : F), (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpoint N L) (W x) = 0) (basis : ι → F),
  HasDerivAt (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.literalColumnMatrix hL W hW basis)
    (fun i j =>
      Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedCurrentForm L
        ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCurrentInclusion N hL) (W (basis i)))
        ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCurrentInclusion N hL) (W (basis j))))
    (1 / 2)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.integrable_weighted_cut_translation
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 ≤ L →
    ∀ (b : ℂ) (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun p => Complex.exp (-b * ↑p.1) * (Set.Ico 0 L).indicator (fun t => ↑↑↑f (p.1 + t)) p.2)
        ((MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioc 0 L)).prod MeasureTheory.volume)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra_ae_integral
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 ≤ L →
    ∀ (b : ℂ) (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
      ↑↑↑((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L b) f) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume] fun t =>
        ∫ (y : ℝ) in Set.Ioc 0 L, Complex.exp (-b * ↑y) * (Set.Ico 0 L).indicator (fun t => ↑↑↑f (y + t)) t

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.weighted_translated_integral
type:
∀ {L t : ℝ},
  0 ≤ L →
    ∀ (b : ℂ) (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
      t ∈ Set.Ico 0 L →
        ∫ (y : ℝ) in Set.Ioc 0 L, Complex.exp (-b * ↑y) * ↑↑↑f (y + t) =
          ∫ (u : ℝ) in t..L, Complex.exp (-b * ↑(u - t)) * ↑↑↑f u

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra_ae
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 ≤ L →
    ∀ (b : ℂ) (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
      ↑↑↑((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L b) f) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume]
        (Set.Ico 0 L).indicator fun t => ∫ (u : ℝ) in t..L, Complex.exp (-b * ↑(u - t)) * ↑↑↑f u

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedCoefficients
type: (N : ℕ) → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedShift
type: (N : ℕ) → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N →L[ℂ] Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedShift_hermitian
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L y : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    y ∈ Set.Icc 0 L →
      ∀ (w d : ℝ),
        Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedShift N L y w d +
            ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedShift N L y w d) =
          Riemann.CCM.Native.weilOperator (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedCoefficients N L y w d)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierInclusion_adjoint_comp
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierInclusion N L) ∘SL
        Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierInclusion N L =
      1

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedOrbit
type: {N : ℕ} → (L : ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N → ℝ → ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedOrbit_compression
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (w d : ℝ → ℝ) (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N) (y : ℝ),
      (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierInclusion N L))
          (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedOrbit L w d x y) =
        (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedShift N L y (w y) (d y)) x

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedShift_entry_integrable
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (w d : ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
          MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedOrbit L w d x) (Set.Ioo 0 L)
            MeasureTheory.volume) →
        ∀ (i j : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
          MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
            (fun y =>
              ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedShift N L y (w y) (d y)) (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)).ofLp i)
            (Set.Ioo 0 L) MeasureTheory.volume

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedCoefficients_integrable
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (w d : ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
          MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedOrbit L w d x) (Set.Ioo 0 L)
            MeasureTheory.volume) →
        (∀ (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
            MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
              (fun y => (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedCoefficients N L y (w y) (d y)).diagonal i)
              (Set.Ioo 0 L) MeasureTheory.volume) ∧
          ∀ (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
            MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
              (fun y => (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedCoefficients N L y (w y) (d y)).beta i) (Set.Ioo 0 L)
              MeasureTheory.volume

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedIntegral
type:
{N : ℕ} →
  (L : ℝ) →
    (w d : ℝ → ℝ) →
      (∀ (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
          MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedOrbit L w d x) (Set.Ioo 0 L)
            MeasureTheory.volume) →
        Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N →L[ℂ] Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedIntegral_entry
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (w d : ℝ → ℝ)
      (hf :
        ∀ (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
          MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedOrbit L w d x) (Set.Ioo 0 L)
            MeasureTheory.volume)
      (i j : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
      ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedIntegral L w d hf) (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)).ofLp i =
        ∫ (y : ℝ) in Set.Ioo 0 L,
          ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedShift N L y (w y) (d y)) (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)).ofLp i

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedIntegral_weilOperator
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (w d : ℝ → ℝ)
      (hf :
        ∀ (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
          MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedOrbit L w d x) (Set.Ioo 0 L)
            MeasureTheory.volume),
      Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedIntegral L w d hf +
          ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedIntegral L w d hf) =
        Riemann.CCM.Native.weilOperator
          (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.integralCoefficients (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioo 0 L)) fun y =>
            Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedCoefficients N L y (w y) (d y))

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedCoefficients
type: (N : ℕ) → ℝ → Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedCompression
type: (N : ℕ) → {L : ℝ} → 0 < L → Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N →L[ℂ] Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedCompression_eq
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L),
  Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedCompression N hL =
    (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompression N L) (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeCurrent L (1 / 2)) +
          Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeGammaCompression N hL -
        (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompression N L) (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L (1 / 2)) -
      (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompression N L) (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L (-(1 / 2)))

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompleted_weilOperator
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L),
  Riemann.CCM.Native.weilOperator (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedCoefficients N L) =
    -(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedCompression N hL +
        ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedCompression N hL))

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedCurrent_form
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (x y : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
  Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedCurrentForm L ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCurrentInclusion N hL) x)
      ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCurrentInclusion N hL) y) =
    inner ℂ x ((Riemann.CCM.Native.weilOperator (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedCoefficients N L)) y)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.memLp_cut_continuous
type: ∀ (L : ℝ) {f : ℝ → ℂ}, Continuous f → MeasureTheory.MemLp ((Set.Ico 0 L).indicator f) 2 MeasureTheory.volume

type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Continuous f),

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.contDiff_nativeFourier
type: ∀ {N : ℕ} (L : ℝ) (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N), ContDiff ℝ ⊤ (Riemann.CCM.Native.fourierFunction L x)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierHilbert_ae
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (L : ℝ) (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
  ↑↑↑(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierHilbert L x) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume]
    (Set.Ico 0 L).indicator (Riemann.CCM.Native.fourierFunction L x)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierInclusionLinearMap
type: (N : ℕ) → (L : ℝ) → Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N →ₗ[ℂ] ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierInclusion
type: (N : ℕ) → (L : ℝ) → Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N →L[ℂ] ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierInclusion_apply
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (L : ℝ) (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
  (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierInclusion N L) x = Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierHilbert L x

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.hasDerivAt_nativeFourier
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (L : ℝ) (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N) (t : ℝ),
  HasDerivAt (Riemann.CCM.Native.fourierFunction L x)
    (Riemann.CCM.Native.fourierFunction L (Complex.I • (Riemann.CCM.Native.derivative L) x) t) t

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeFourier_hasGenerator
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
      (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpoint N L) x = 0 →
        Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.HasGenerator L (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierHilbert L x)
          (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierHilbert L (Complex.I • (Riemann.CCM.Native.derivative L) x))

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.inner_ofContinuous
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 ≤ L →
    ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g),
      inner ℂ (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.ofContinuous L f hf) (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.ofContinuous L g hg) =
        ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..L, star (f t) * g t

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.integral_frequency_difference
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (i j : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
      ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..L,
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * (↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L j) - ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i)) * ↑t) =
        if i = j then ↑L else 0

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.integral_fourier_summands
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (i j : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N) (a b : ℂ),
      ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..L,
          star (a * (↑√L)⁻¹ * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i) * ↑t))) *
            (b * (↑√L)⁻¹ * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L j) * ↑t))) =
        if i = j then star a * b else 0

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.integral_fourier_inner
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (x y : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
      ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..L, star (Riemann.CCM.Native.fourierFunction L x t) * Riemann.CCM.Native.fourierFunction L y t =
        inner ℂ x y

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierHilbert_inner
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (x y : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
      inner ℂ (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierHilbert L x) (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierHilbert L y) =
        inner ℂ x y

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierIsometry
type: (N : ℕ) → {L : ℝ} → 0 < L → Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N →ₗᵢ[ℂ] ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierIsometry_apply
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
  (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierIsometry N hL) x = Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierHilbert L x

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.norm_fourier_single
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N), ‖Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierHilbert L (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)‖ = 1

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.norm_nativeMode
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N) (t : ℝ),
      ‖(↑√L)⁻¹ * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i) * ↑t))‖ = (√L)⁻¹

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.norm_killed_fourier_single_sq
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (y : NNReal),
      ↑y ≤ L →
        ∀ (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
          ‖(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.killedShift L y)
                  (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierHilbert L (EuclideanSpace.single i 1))‖ ^
              2 =
            (L - ↑y) / L

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.norm_killed_fourier_single_sub_le
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (y : NNReal),
      ↑y ≤ L →
        ∀ (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
          ‖(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.killedShift L y)
                  (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierHilbert L (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) -
                Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierHilbert L (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)‖ ≤
            |Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i| * ↑y + √(↑y / L)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierHilbert_eq_sum_single
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (L : ℝ) (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
  Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierHilbert L x =
    ∑ i, x.ofLp i • Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierHilbert L (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.norm_killed_fourier_sub_le
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (y : NNReal),
      ↑y ≤ L →
        ∀ (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
          ‖(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.killedShift L y) (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierHilbert L x) -
                Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierHilbert L x‖ ≤
            ∑ i, ‖x.ofLp i‖ * (|Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i| * ↑y + √(↑y / L))

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierShiftConstant
type: {N : ℕ} → ℝ → Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N → ℝ

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierShiftConstant_nonneg
type: ∀ {N : ℕ} (L : ℝ) (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N), 0 ≤ Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierShiftConstant L x

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.norm_killed_fourier_sub_le_sqrt
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (y : NNReal),
      ↑y ≤ L →
        ∀ (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
          ‖(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.killedShift L y) (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierHilbert L x) -
                Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierHilbert L x‖ ≤
            Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierShiftConstant L x * √↑y

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.norm_shift_fourier_sub_le_sqrt
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ {y : ℝ},
      0 ≤ y →
        y ≤ L →
          ∀ (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
            ‖(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift L y) (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierHilbert L x) -
                  Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierHilbert L x‖ ≤
              Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierShiftConstant L x * √y

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gamma_compensated_integrable
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedOrbit L Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaWeight
          Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaRemainder x)
        (Set.Ioo 0 L) MeasureTheory.volume

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeGammaCoefficients
type: (N : ℕ) → ℝ → Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeGammaCompression
type: (N : ℕ) → {L : ℝ} → 0 < L → Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N →L[ℂ] Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeGammaCompression_eq
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L),
  Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeGammaCompression N hL =
    ↑(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaConstant L) • 1 +
      Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedIntegral L Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaWeight
        Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaRemainder ⋯

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeGamma_weilOperator
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L),
  Riemann.CCM.Native.weilOperator (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeGammaCoefficients N L) =
    -(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeGammaCompression N hL +
        ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeGammaCompression N hL))

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeGammaCoefficients_beta
type:
∀ (N : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
  (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeGammaCoefficients N L).beta i =
    ∫ (y : ℝ) in Set.Ioo 0 L,
      Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaWeight y * Real.sin (Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i * y) / Real.pi

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeGammaCoefficients_diagonal
type:
∀ (N : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
  (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeGammaCoefficients N L).diagonal i =
    -2 * Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaConstant L -
      2 *
        ∫ (y : ℝ) in Set.Ioo 0 L,
          Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaWeight y *
              ((1 - y / L) * Real.cos (Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i * y) - 1) +
            Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaRemainder y

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.hermitianShiftCoefficients
type: (N : ℕ) → ℝ → ℝ → Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierShiftCompression_entry_offDiagonal
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (y : NNReal),
      ↑y ≤ L →
        ∀ {i j : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N},
          i ≠ j →
            ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierShiftCompression N L y) (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)).ofLp i =
              (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i) * ↑↑y)) -
                  Complex.exp (Complex.I * (↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L j) * ↑↑y))) /
                (Complex.I * ↑L * (↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L j) - ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i)))

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierShiftCompression_symmetric_entries
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (y : NNReal),
      ↑y ≤ L →
        ∀ (i j : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
          ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierShiftCompression N L y) (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)).ofLp i =
            ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierShiftCompression N L y) (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)).ofLp j

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.adjoint_single_entry
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (T : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N →L[ℂ] Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N) (i j : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
  ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T) (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)).ofLp i = star ((T (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)).ofLp j)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.re_div_I_real
type: ∀ (z : ℂ) (d : ℝ), (z / (Complex.I * ↑d)).re = z.im / d

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.hermitianShift_entry
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (y : NNReal),
      ↑y ≤ L →
        ∀ (i j : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
          ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierShiftCompression N L y +
                    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierShiftCompression N L y))
                  (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)).ofLp
              i =
            Riemann.CCM.Native.weilMatrix (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.hermitianShiftCoefficients N L ↑y) i j

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeOperator_ext_single
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {S T : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N →L[ℂ] Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N},
  (∀ (i j : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
      (S (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)).ofLp i = (T (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)).ofLp i) →
    S = T

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.hermitianShift_weilOperator
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (y : NNReal),
      ↑y ≤ L →
        Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierShiftCompression N L y +
            ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierShiftCompression N L y) =
          Riemann.CCM.Native.weilOperator (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.hermitianShiftCoefficients N L ↑y)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.integralCoefficients
type:
{N : ℕ} →
  {Ω : Type u_1} →
    [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] →
      MeasureTheory.Measure Ω → (Ω → Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) → Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.weilMatrix_integralCoefficients
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  (C : Ω → Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N),
  (∀ (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => (C y).beta i) μ) →
    ∀ (i j : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
      Riemann.CCM.Native.weilMatrix (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.integralCoefficients μ C) i j =
        ∫ (y : Ω), Riemann.CCM.Native.weilMatrix (C y) i j ∂μ

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.integrable_weilMatrix
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  (C : Ω → Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N),
  (∀ (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => (C y).diagonal i) μ) →
    (∀ (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => (C y).beta i) μ) →
      ∀ (i j : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => Riemann.CCM.Native.weilMatrix (C y) i j) μ

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.integrable_coefficients_of_entries
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  (C : Ω → Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N),
  (∀ (y : Ω), (C y).beta (Riemann.CCM.Native.zeroIndex N) = 0) →
    (∀ (i j : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => Riemann.CCM.Native.weilMatrix (C y) i j) μ) →
      (∀ (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => (C y).diagonal i) μ) ∧
        ∀ (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => (C y).beta i) μ

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.scalarCoefficients
type: (N : ℕ) → ℝ → Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.weilOperator_scalarCoefficients
type:
∀ (N : ℕ) (c : ℝ),
  Riemann.CCM.Native.weilOperator (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.scalarCoefficients N c) =
    ↑c • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ (Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.addCoefficients
type: {N : ℕ} → Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N → Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N → Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.scaleCoefficients
type: {N : ℕ} → ℝ → Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N → Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.weilMatrix_addCoefficients
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C D : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (i j : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
  Riemann.CCM.Native.weilMatrix (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.addCoefficients C D) i j =
    Riemann.CCM.Native.weilMatrix C i j + Riemann.CCM.Native.weilMatrix D i j

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.weilMatrix_scaleCoefficients
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (a : ℝ) (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (i j : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
  Riemann.CCM.Native.weilMatrix (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.scaleCoefficients a C) i j =
    ↑a * Riemann.CCM.Native.weilMatrix C i j

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.weilOperator_addCoefficients
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C D : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N),
  Riemann.CCM.Native.weilOperator (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.addCoefficients C D) =
    Riemann.CCM.Native.weilOperator C + Riemann.CCM.Native.weilOperator D

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.weilOperator_scaleCoefficients
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (a : ℝ) (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N),
  Riemann.CCM.Native.weilOperator (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.scaleCoefficients a C) =
    ↑a • Riemann.CCM.Native.weilOperator C

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.realVolterraWeight
type: ℝ → ℝ → ℝ

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.realVolterra_compensatedOrbit
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (L b : ℝ) (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
  Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedOrbit L (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.realVolterraWeight b)
      (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.realVolterraWeight b) x =
    Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.weightedOrbit L (↑b) (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierHilbert L x)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.realVolterra_compensated_integrable
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (b : ℝ) (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedOrbit L (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.realVolterraWeight b)
          (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.realVolterraWeight b) x)
        (Set.Ioo 0 L) MeasureTheory.volume

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeRealVolterraCoefficients
type: (N : ℕ) → ℝ → ℝ → Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.realVolterra_compression_eq
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (b : ℝ),
  (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompression N L) (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L ↑b) =
    Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.compensatedIntegral L (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.realVolterraWeight b)
      (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.realVolterraWeight b) ⋯

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeRealVolterra_weilOperator
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (b : ℝ),
      Riemann.CCM.Native.weilOperator (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeRealVolterraCoefficients N L b) =
        (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompression N L) (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L ↑b) +
          ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint
            ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompression N L) (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L ↑b))

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativePolarCoefficients
type: (N : ℕ) → ℝ → Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativePolar_weilOperator
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    Riemann.CCM.Native.weilOperator (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativePolarCoefficients N L) =
      (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompression N L)
          (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L (1 / 2) + Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L (-(1 / 2))) +
        ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint
          ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompression N L)
            (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L (1 / 2) + Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L (-(1 / 2))))

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeRealVolterraCoefficients_beta
type:
∀ (N : ℕ) (L b : ℝ) (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
  (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeRealVolterraCoefficients N L b).beta i =
    ∫ (y : ℝ) in Set.Ioo 0 L, -Real.exp (-b * y) * Real.sin (Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i * y) / Real.pi

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeRealVolterraCoefficients_diagonal
type:
∀ (N : ℕ) (L b : ℝ) (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
  (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeRealVolterraCoefficients N L b).diagonal i =
    ∫ (y : ℝ) in Set.Ioo 0 L, 2 * Real.exp (-b * y) * (1 - y / L) * Real.cos (Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i * y)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompression
type:
(N : ℕ) →
  (L : ℝ) →
    (↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L) →L[ℂ] ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)) →L[ℂ]
      Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N →L[ℂ] Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompression_apply
type:
∀ (N : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (T : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L) →L[ℂ] ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
  (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompression N L) T =
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierInclusion N L) ∘SL
      T ∘SL Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierInclusion N L

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompression_killedShift
type:
∀ (N : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (y : NNReal),
  (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompression N L) (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.killedShift L y) =
    Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierShiftCompression N L y

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.sumCoefficients
type:
{N : ℕ} →
  {ι : Type u_1} → Finset ι → (ι → ℝ) → (ι → Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) → Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.weilMatrix_sumCoefficients
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ) (C : ι → Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N)
  (i j : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
  Riemann.CCM.Native.weilMatrix (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.sumCoefficients s w C) i j =
    ∑ a ∈ s, ↑(w a) * Riemann.CCM.Native.weilMatrix (C a) i j

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.weilOperator_sumCoefficients
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ) (C : ι → Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N),
  Riemann.CCM.Native.weilOperator (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.sumCoefficients s w C) =
    ∑ a ∈ s, ↑(w a) • Riemann.CCM.Native.weilOperator (C a)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeSurvivors
type: ℝ → Finset ℕ

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeRealWeight
type: ℝ → ℕ → ℝ

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativePrimeCoefficients
type: (N : ℕ) → ℝ → ℝ → Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeCurrent_sum_survivors
type:
∀ (L σ : ℝ),
  Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeCurrent L σ =
    ∑ n ∈ Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeSurvivors L,
      ↑(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeRealWeight σ n) •
        Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.killedShift L (Riemann.Arithmetic.natLog n)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompression_primeCurrent
type:
∀ (N : ℕ) (L σ : ℝ),
  (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompression N L) (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeCurrent L σ) =
    ∑ n ∈ Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeSurvivors L,
      ↑(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeRealWeight σ n) •
        Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierShiftCompression N L (Riemann.Arithmetic.natLog n)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativePrime_weilOperator
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (σ : ℝ),
      Riemann.CCM.Native.weilOperator (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativePrimeCoefficients N L σ) =
        -((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompression N L) (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeCurrent L σ) +
            ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint
              ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompression N L) (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeCurrent L σ)))

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativePrimeCoefficients_beta
type:
∀ (N : ℕ) (L σ : ℝ) (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
  (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativePrimeCoefficients N L σ).beta i =
    ∑ n ∈ Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeSurvivors L,
      Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeRealWeight σ n * Real.sin (Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i * Real.log ↑n) /
        Real.pi

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativePrimeCoefficients_diagonal
type:
∀ (N : ℕ) (L σ : ℝ) (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
  (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativePrimeCoefficients N L σ).diagonal i =
    -2 *
      ∑ n ∈ Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeSurvivors L,
        Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeRealWeight σ n * (1 - Real.log ↑n / L) *
          Real.cos (Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i * Real.log ↑n)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.inner_ofContinuous_killedShift
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 ≤ L →
    ∀ (y : NNReal),
      ↑y ≤ L →
        ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g),
          inner ℂ (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.ofContinuous L f hf)
              ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.killedShift L y) (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.ofContinuous L g hg)) =
            ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..L - ↑y, star (f t) * g (t + ↑y)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierFunction_single
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (L : ℝ) (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
  Riemann.CCM.Native.fourierFunction L (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) = fun t =>
    (↑√L)⁻¹ * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i) * ↑t))

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierShiftCompression
type: (N : ℕ) → ℝ → NNReal → Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N →L[ℂ] Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierShiftCompression_entry
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (L : ℝ) (y : NNReal) (i j : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
  ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierShiftCompression N L y) (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)).ofLp i =
    inner ℂ (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierHilbert L (EuclideanSpace.single i 1))
      ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.killedShift L y)
        (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierHilbert L (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)))

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierShiftCompression_entry_integral
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (y : NNReal),
      ↑y ≤ L →
        ∀ (i j : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
          ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierShiftCompression N L y) (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)).ofLp i =
            (↑L)⁻¹ * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L j) * ↑↑y)) *
              ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..L - ↑y,
                Complex.exp
                  (Complex.I * (↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L j) - ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i)) * ↑t)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierShiftCompression_entry_explicit
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (y : NNReal),
      ↑y ≤ L →
        ∀ (i j : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
          ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierShiftCompression N L y) (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)).ofLp i =
            (↑L)⁻¹ * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L j) * ↑↑y)) *
              if i = j then ↑(L - ↑y)
              else
                (Complex.exp
                      (Complex.I * (↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L j) - ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i)) *
                        ↑(L - ↑y)) -
                    1) /
                  (Complex.I * (↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L j) - ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i)))

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierShiftCompression_eq_zero
type: ∀ (N : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (y : NNReal), L ≤ ↑y → Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierShiftCompression N L y = 0

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.hasDerivAt_nativeSourceWeil
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (x y : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N) (hx : (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpoint N L) x = 0)
  (hy : (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpoint N L) y = 0),
  HasDerivAt
    (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedSourceGram L (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedSource hL x hx)
      (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedSource hL y hy))
    (inner ℂ x ((Riemann.CCM.Native.weilOperator (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedCoefficients N L)) y))
    (1 / 2)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.hasDerivAt_literalColumnMetric_weil
type:
∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] {N : ℕ}
  {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (W : F →L[ℂ] Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N)
  (hW : ∀ (x : F), (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpoint N L) (W x) = 0) (x y : F),
  HasDerivAt (fun σ => inner ℂ x ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.literalColumnMetric hL W hW σ) y))
    (inner ℂ (W x)
      ((Riemann.CCM.Native.weilOperator (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedCoefficients N L)) (W y)))
    (1 / 2)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.native_columnEnergy_sourceDerivative
type:
∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] {N : ℕ}
  {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L)
  (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedCoefficients N L))
  (W : F →L[ℂ] Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N) (hW : ∀ (x : F), (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpoint N L) (W x) = 0) (x y : F),
  inner ℂ x
      ((Riemann.Capacity.columnEnergy
          (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeShifted (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedCoefficients N L) A) W)
        y) =
    deriv (fun σ => inner ℂ x ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.literalColumnMetric hL W hW σ) y)) (1 / 2) -
      ↑A.e₀ * inner ℂ x ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.literalColumnMetric hL W hW (1 / 2)) y)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.hasDerivAt_literalColumnMatrix_weil
type:
∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] {N : ℕ}
  {L : ℝ} {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype ι] (hL : 0 < L) (W : F →L[ℂ] Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N)
  (hW : ∀ (x : F), (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpoint N L) (W x) = 0) (basis : ι → F),
  HasDerivAt (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.literalColumnMatrix hL W hW basis)
    (Matrix.of fun i j =>
      inner ℂ (W (basis i))
        ((Riemann.CCM.Native.weilOperator (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedCoefficients N L))
          (W (basis j))))
    (1 / 2)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.native_columnEnergy_sourceMatrix
type:
∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] {N : ℕ}
  {L : ℝ} {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype ι] (hL : 0 < L)
  (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedCoefficients N L))
  (W : F →L[ℂ] Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N) (hW : ∀ (x : F), (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpoint N L) (W x) = 0)
  (basis : ι → F),
  (Matrix.of fun i j =>
      inner ℂ (basis i)
        ((Riemann.Capacity.columnEnergy
            (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeShifted (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedCoefficients N L) A) W)
          (basis j))) =
    deriv (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.literalColumnMatrix hL W hW basis) (1 / 2) -
      ↑A.e₀ • Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.literalColumnMatrix hL W hW basis (1 / 2)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.native_correctedEnergy_sourceMatrix
type:
∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] {N : ℕ}
  {L : ℝ} {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype ι] (hL : 0 < L)
  (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedCoefficients N L))
  (W : F →L[ℂ] Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N) (p : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N)
  (hp : (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpoint N L) p = 1) (basis : ι → F),
  let D₀ :=
    Riemann.Capacity.endpointCorrectedColumns (Riemann.CCM.Native.derivative L ∘SL W)
      (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpointVector N L) p;
  have hD₀ := ⋯;
  (Matrix.of fun i j =>
      inner ℂ (basis i)
        ((Riemann.Capacity.columnEnergy
            (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeShifted (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedCoefficients N L) A) D₀)
          (basis j))) =
    deriv (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.literalColumnMatrix hL D₀ hD₀ basis) (1 / 2) -
      ↑A.e₀ • Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.literalColumnMatrix hL D₀ hD₀ basis (1 / 2)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.continuous_tailIntegral
type: ∀ {f : ℝ → ℂ}, Continuous f → ∀ (b : ℝ), Continuous fun t => ∫ (u : ℝ) in t..b, f u

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.integral_tail_product
type:
∀ {f g : ℝ → ℂ},
  Continuous f →
    Continuous g →
      ∀ (a b : ℝ),
        ∫ (t : ℝ) in a..b, (f t * ∫ (u : ℝ) in t..b, g u) + g t * ∫ (u : ℝ) in t..b, f u =
          (∫ (t : ℝ) in a..b, f t) * ∫ (t : ℝ) in a..b, g t

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterraRepresentative
type: ℝ → ℂ → (ℝ → ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.continuous_volterraRepresentative
type: ∀ (L : ℝ) (b : ℂ) {f : ℝ → ℂ}, Continuous f → Continuous (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterraRepresentative L b f)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterraRepresentative_eq
type:
∀ (L t : ℝ) (b : ℂ) {f : ℝ → ℂ},
  Continuous f →
    Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterraRepresentative L b f t = ∫ (u : ℝ) in t..L, Complex.exp (-b * ↑(u - t)) * f u

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra_ofContinuous
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 ≤ L →
    ∀ (b : ℂ) {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : Continuous f),
      (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L b) (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.ofContinuous L f hf) =
        Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.ofContinuous L (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterraRepresentative L b f) ⋯

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterraRepresentative_real
type:
∀ (L t b : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℂ),
  Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterraRepresentative L (↑b) f t =
    ↑(Real.exp (b * t)) * ∫ (u : ℝ) in t..L, ↑(Real.exp (-b * u)) * f u

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.inner_volterra_cross
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 ≤ L →
    ∀ (b : ℝ) {f g : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g),
      inner ℂ (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.ofContinuous L f hf)
            ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L ↑b) (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.ofContinuous L g hg)) +
          inner ℂ ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L (-↑b)) (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.ofContinuous L f hf))
            (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.ofContinuous L g hg) =
        (∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..L, ↑(Real.exp (b * t)) * star (f t)) * ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..L, ↑(Real.exp (-b * t)) * g t

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.polarKernel
type: ℝ → ℝ → ℂ

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.polarKernel_cosh
type: ∀ (t u : ℝ), Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.polarKernel t u = ↑(2 * Real.cosh ((t - u) / 2))

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.polarKernel_separable
type:
∀ (t u : ℝ),
  Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.polarKernel t u =
    ↑(Real.exp (t / 2)) * ↑(Real.exp (-u / 2)) + ↑(Real.exp (-t / 2)) * ↑(Real.exp (u / 2))

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.inner_polarVolterra
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 ≤ L →
    ∀ {f g : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g),
      inner ℂ (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.ofContinuous L f hf)
            ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L (1 / 2) + Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L (-(1 / 2)))
              (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.ofContinuous L g hg)) +
          inner ℂ
            ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L (1 / 2) + Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L (-(1 / 2)))
              (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.ofContinuous L f hf))
            (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.ofContinuous L g hg) =
        ((∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..L, ↑(Real.exp (t / 2)) * star (f t)) * ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..L, ↑(Real.exp (-t / 2)) * g t) +
          (∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..L, ↑(Real.exp (-t / 2)) * star (f t)) * ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..L, ↑(Real.exp (t / 2)) * g t

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.resolventFactor
type: (L : ℝ) → ℂ → ℂ → ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L) →L[ℂ] ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.resolventFactor_inverse
type:
∀ (L : ℝ),
  0 ≤ L →
    ∀ (b d : ℂ),
      Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.resolventFactor L b d *
          Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.resolventFactor L (b + d) (-d) =
        1

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.resolventFactor_inverse_left
type:
∀ (L : ℝ),
  0 ≤ L →
    ∀ (b d : ℂ),
      Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.resolventFactor L (b + d) (-d) *
          Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.resolventFactor L b d =
        1

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.polarOperator
type: (L : ℝ) → ℝ → ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L) →L[ℂ] ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.polarInverse
type: (L : ℝ) → ℝ → ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L) →L[ℂ] ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.polarOperator_mul_inverse
type:
∀ (L : ℝ),
  0 ≤ L →
    ∀ (σ : ℝ), Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.polarOperator L σ * Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.polarInverse L σ = 1

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.polarInverse_mul
type:
∀ (L : ℝ),
  0 ≤ L →
    ∀ (σ : ℝ), Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.polarInverse L σ * Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.polarOperator L σ = 1

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.polarDerivative
type: (L : ℝ) → ℝ → ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L) →L[ℂ] ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.hasDerivAt_polarOperator
type:
∀ (L σ : ℝ),
  HasDerivAt (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.polarOperator L) (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.polarDerivative L σ) σ

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.resolventFactor_mul_resolvent
type:
∀ (L : ℝ),
  0 ≤ L →
    ∀ (b d : ℂ),
      Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.resolventFactor L b d * Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L (b + d) =
        Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L b

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.resolventFactor_commute_resolvent
type:
∀ (L : ℝ),
  0 ≤ L →
    ∀ (b d c : ℂ),
      Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.resolventFactor L b d * Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L c =
        Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L c * Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.resolventFactor L b d

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.polarDerivative_eq
type:
∀ (L : ℝ),
  0 ≤ L →
    ∀ (σ : ℝ),
      Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.polarDerivative L σ =
        Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.polarOperator L σ *
          (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L ↑σ + Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L (↑σ - 1))

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.polar_negative_logarithmic_derivative
type:
∀ (L : ℝ),
  0 ≤ L →
    ∀ (σ : ℝ),
      -(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.polarInverse L σ * Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.polarDerivative L σ) =
        -Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L ↑σ - Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L (↑σ - 1)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.polar_current_half
type:
∀ (L : ℝ),
  0 ≤ L →
    -(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.polarInverse L (1 / 2) * Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.polarDerivative L (1 / 2)) =
      -Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L (1 / 2) - Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L (-(1 / 2))

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeShift
type: (L : ℝ) → ℕ →*₀ ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L) →L[ℂ] ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeShift_killed
type: ∀ (L : ℝ) {n : ℕ}, Real.exp L ≤ ↑n → (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeShift L) n = 0

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeAlgebra
type: (L : ℝ) → Subalgebra ℂ (↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L) →L[ℂ] ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L))

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeCharacter
type: (L : ℝ) → ℕ →*₀ ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeAlgebra L)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeWeight
type: (L : ℝ) → ℝ → ℕ →*₀ ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeAlgebra L)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeCutoff
type: ℝ → ℕ

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeWeight_killed
type:
∀ (L σ : ℝ) {n : ℕ},
  Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeCutoff L < n → (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeWeight L σ) n = 0

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeCutoff_pos
type: ∀ (L : ℝ), 1 ≤ Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeCutoff L

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeOperator
type: (L : ℝ) → ℝ → ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L) →L[ℂ] ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeInverse
type: (L : ℝ) → ℝ → ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L) →L[ℂ] ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeDerivative
type: (L : ℝ) → ℝ → ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L) →L[ℂ] ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeCurrent
type: (L : ℝ) → ℝ → ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L) →L[ℂ] ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeInverse_mul
type: ∀ (L σ : ℝ), Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeInverse L σ * Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeOperator L σ = 1

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeOperator_mul_inverse
type: ∀ (L σ : ℝ), Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeOperator L σ * Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeInverse L σ = 1

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.prime_negative_logarithmic_derivative
type:
∀ (L σ : ℝ),
  -(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeInverse L σ * Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeDerivative L σ) =
    Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeCurrent L σ

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeWeight_coe
type:
∀ (L σ : ℝ) {n : ℕ},
  n ≠ 0 →
    ↑((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeWeight L σ) n) =
      Complex.exp (-↑σ * ↑(Real.log ↑n)) • (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeShift L) n

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.prime_synthesis_sum
type:
∀ (L σ : ℝ) (f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ),
  ↑(Riemann.Arithmetic.synthesis (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeCutoff L)
        (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeWeight L σ) f) =
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeCutoff L),
      ↑(f n) • Complex.exp (-↑σ * ↑(Real.log ↑n)) • (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeShift L) n

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeOperator_sum
type:
∀ (L σ : ℝ),
  Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeOperator L σ =
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeCutoff L),
      Complex.exp (-↑σ * ↑(Real.log ↑n)) • (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeShift L) n

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeDerivative_sum
type:
∀ (L σ : ℝ),
  Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeDerivative L σ =
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeCutoff L),
      (-↑(Real.log ↑n) * Complex.exp (-↑σ * ↑(Real.log ↑n))) • (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeShift L) n

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.hasDerivAt_primeOperator
type:
∀ (L σ : ℝ),
  HasDerivAt (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeOperator L) (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeDerivative L σ) σ

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeOperator_euler_product
type:
∀ (L σ : ℝ),
  Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeOperator L σ =
    ↑(∏ p ∈ (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeCutoff L + 1).primesBelow,
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeCutoff L + 1),
          (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeWeight L σ) p ^ k)

name: Riemann.Analysis.currentForm
type:
{E : Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] → [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] → (D : Submodule ℂ E) → (↥D →ₗ[ℂ] E) → ↥D → ↥D → ℂ

name: Riemann.Analysis.currentForm_hermitian
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] (D : Submodule ℂ E) (J : ↥D →ₗ[ℂ] E)
  (u v : ↥D), Riemann.Analysis.currentForm D J v u = (starRingEnd ℂ) (Riemann.Analysis.currentForm D J u v)

name: Riemann.Analysis.hasDerivAt_frozenSourceGram
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] {X : ℝ → E →L[ℂ] E} {X' : E →L[ℂ] E}
  {a : ℝ},
  HasDerivAt X X' a →
    ∀ (u v : E),
      HasDerivAt (fun s => inner ℂ ((X s) u) ((X s) v)) (inner ℂ ((X a) u) (X' v) + inner ℂ (X' u) ((X a) v)) a

name: Riemann.Analysis.hasDerivAt_frozenSourceGram_current
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] {X : ℝ → E →L[ℂ] E} {X' : E →L[ℂ] E}
  {a : ℝ},
  HasDerivAt X X' a →
    ∀ (D : Submodule ℂ E) (J : ↥D →ₗ[ℂ] E) (hmem : ∀ (u : E), (X a) u ∈ D),
      (∀ (u : E), X' u = -J ⟨(X a) u, ⋯⟩) →
        ∀ (u v : E),
          HasDerivAt (fun s => inner ℂ ((X s) u) ((X s) v)) (Riemann.Analysis.currentForm D J ⟨(X a) u, ⋯⟩ ⟨(X a) v, ⋯⟩)
            a

name: Riemann.Analysis.hasDerivAt_frozenSourceColumnGram
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype ι]
  {X : ℝ → E →L[ℂ] E} {X' : E →L[ℂ] E} {a : ℝ},
  HasDerivAt X X' a →
    ∀ (U : ι → E),
      HasDerivAt (fun s i j => inner ℂ ((X s) (U i)) ((X s) (U j)))
        (fun i j => inner ℂ ((X a) (U i)) (X' (U j)) + inner ℂ (X' (U i)) ((X a) (U j))) a

name: Riemann.Analysis.StrongContractionFamily.kernelOperator_apply
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E]

name: Riemann.Analysis.StrongContractionFamily.norm_kernelOperator_le
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace ℂ E] [inst_3 : CompleteSpace E] (S : Riemann.Analysis.StrongContractionFamily μ E)

type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace ℂ E] [inst_3 : CompleteSpace E] (S : Riemann.Analysis.StrongContractionFamily μ E)

type:

  [inst_2 : NormedSpace ℂ E] [inst_3 : CompleteSpace E] (S : Riemann.Analysis.StrongContractionFamily μ E),
