type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace ℂ E] [inst_3 : CompleteSpace E] (S : Riemann.Analysis.StrongContractionFamily μ E)
  {k : ℝ → ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 1 μ)} {k' : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 1 μ)} {a : ℝ},
  HasDerivAt k k' a → HasDerivAt (fun s => S.integration (k s)) (S.integration k') a

name: Riemann.Analysis.StrongContractionFamily.kernelOperator_commute
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace ℂ E] [inst_3 : CompleteSpace E] (S : Riemann.Analysis.StrongContractionFamily μ E)
  (T : E →L[ℂ] E),
  (∀ (y : Ω) (u : E), T ((S.operator y) u) = (S.operator y) (T u)) →
    ∀ (k : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 1 μ)), T ∘SL S.kernelOperator k = S.kernelOperator k ∘SL T

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.weightedOrbit
type: (L : ℝ) → ℂ → ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L) → ℝ → ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.continuous_weightedOrbit
type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (b : ℂ) (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
  Continuous (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.weightedOrbit L b f)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.norm_weightedOrbit_le
type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (b : ℂ) (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)) {y : ℝ},
  y ∈ Set.uIcc 0 L → ‖Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.weightedOrbit L b f y‖ ≤ Real.exp (‖b‖ * |L|) * ‖f‖

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.norm_volterra_integral_le
type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (b : ℂ) (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
  ‖∫ (y : ℝ) in 0..L, Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.weightedOrbit L b f y‖ ≤ |L| * Real.exp (‖b‖ * |L|) * ‖f‖

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterraLinearMap
type: (L : ℝ) → ℂ → ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L) →ₗ[ℂ] ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra
type: (L : ℝ) → ℂ → ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L) →L[ℂ] ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra_apply
type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (b : ℂ) (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
  (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L b) f =
    ∫ (y : ℝ) in 0..L, Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.weightedOrbit L b f y

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.norm_volterra_le
type: ∀ (L : ℝ) (b : ℂ), ‖Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L b‖ ≤ |L| * Real.exp (‖b‖ * |L|)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.weightedOrbit_zero
type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (b : ℂ) (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
  Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.weightedOrbit L b f 0 = f

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.weightedOrbit_eq_zero
type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (b : ℂ) (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)) {y : ℝ},
  L ≤ y → Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.weightedOrbit L b f y = 0

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift_weightedOrbit
type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (b : ℂ) (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)) {h y : ℝ},
  0 ≤ h →
    0 ≤ y →
      (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift L h) (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.weightedOrbit L b f y) =
        Complex.exp (b * ↑h) • Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.weightedOrbit L b f (y + h)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift_volterra
type:
∀ (L : ℝ),
  0 ≤ L →
    ∀ (b : ℂ) (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)) {h : ℝ},
      0 ≤ h →
        (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.shift L h) ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L b) f) =
          Complex.exp (b * ↑h) •
            ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L b) f -
              ∫ (y : ℝ) in 0..h, Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.weightedOrbit L b f y)

name: Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.logPrimitive
type: ℝ → ℝ

name: Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.currentConstant
type: ℝ

name: Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.limitingCurrentKernel
type: ℝ → ℝ

name: Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.cutoffCurrentKernel
type: ℝ → ℝ → ℝ

name: Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.hasDerivAt_half_log
type:
∀ {y : ℝ},
  0 < y → HasDerivAt (fun y => Real.log (1 - Real.exp (-2 * y)) / 2) (Real.exp (-2 * y) / (1 - Real.exp (-2 * y))) y

name: Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.hasDerivAt_logPrimitive
type: ∀ {y : ℝ}, 0 < y → HasDerivAt Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.logPrimitive (1 - Real.exp (-2 * y))⁻¹ y

name: Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.continuousOn_inverse_base
type: ∀ {a b : ℝ}, 0 < a → ContinuousOn (fun y => (1 - Real.exp (-2 * y))⁻¹) (Set.Icc a b)

name: Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.integral_inverse_base
type:
∀ {δ t : ℝ},
  0 < δ →
    δ ≤ t →
      ∫ (y : ℝ) in δ..t, (1 - Real.exp (-2 * y))⁻¹ =
        Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.logPrimitive t - Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.logPrimitive δ

name: Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.integral_scalar_subtraction
type:
∀ {δ t : ℝ},
  0 < δ →
    δ ≤ t →
      ∫ (y : ℝ) in δ..t, Real.exp (-2 * y) / (1 - Real.exp (-2 * y)) =
        Real.log (1 - Real.exp (-2 * t)) / 2 - Real.log (1 - Real.exp (-2 * δ)) / 2

name: Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.cutoffCurrentKernel_of_lt
type:
∀ {δ y : ℝ},
  δ < y →
    Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.cutoffCurrentKernel δ y =
      Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.limitingCurrentKernel y - δ * Real.exp (-y / 2)

name: Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.cutoffCurrentKernel_of_le
type:
∀ {δ y : ℝ},
  y ≤ δ →
    Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.cutoffCurrentKernel δ y =
      Real.exp (-y / 2) * (Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.currentConstant + Real.log (1 - Real.exp (-2 * δ)) / 2)

name: Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.limitingCurrentKernel_eq
type:
∀ (y : ℝ),
  2 * Real.pi * Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.limitingCurrentKernel y =
    -Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.criticalDerivative y

name: Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.logMajorant
type: ℝ → ℝ → ℝ

name: Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.logMajorant_nonneg
type: ∀ (L y : ℝ), 0 ≤ y → 0 ≤ Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.logMajorant L y

name: Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.abs_log_base_le
type: ∀ {L y : ℝ}, y ∈ Set.Ioo 0 L → |Real.log (1 - Real.exp (-2 * y))| ≤ Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.logMajorant L y

name: Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.logMajorant_integrable
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 < L → MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.logMajorant L) (Set.Ioo 0 L) MeasureTheory.volume

name: Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.log_base_monotone
type: ∀ {y δ : ℝ}, 0 < y → y ≤ δ → Real.log (1 - Real.exp (-2 * y)) ≤ Real.log (1 - Real.exp (-2 * δ))

name: Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.log_base_nonpos
type: ∀ {y : ℝ}, 0 < y → Real.log (1 - Real.exp (-2 * y)) ≤ 0

name: Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.norm_limitingCurrentKernel_le
type:
∀ {L y : ℝ},
  y ∈ Set.Ioo 0 L →
    ‖Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.limitingCurrentKernel y‖ ≤
      |Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.currentConstant| + L + Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.logMajorant L y / 2

name: Riemann.Analysis.GammaCompletion.norm_cutoffCurrentKernel_sub_le
type:
∀ {L δ y : ℝ},
  0 < δ →
    δ ≤ L →
      y ∈ Set.Ioo 0 L →

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawEuler
type: ↥Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.compactSupport →ₗ[ℂ] ↥Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.Hilbert

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawEuler_eq_partialSum
type:
∀ (f : ↥Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.compactSupport) (L : ℝ),
  ↑↑f ∈ Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.supported L →
    Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawEuler f =
      (Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawPartialSum (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeCutoff L)) ↑f

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawEuler_finiteInclusion
type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
  Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawEuler ((Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.finiteCoreInclusion L hL) f) =
    (Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.finiteInclusion L) ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeOperator L (1 / 2)) f)

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.ambient_finset_sum_ae
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.Ambient),
  ↑↑(∑ i ∈ s, F i) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume] fun t => ∑ i ∈ s, ↑↑(F i) t

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawPartialSum_ae
type:
∀ (X : ℕ) (f : ↥Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.Hilbert),
  ↑↑↑((Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawPartialSum X) f) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume] fun t =>
    if 0 ≤ t then ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 X, Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawWeight n * ↑↑↑f (Real.log ↑n + t) else 0

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawEuler_box_tendsto
type:
Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawEuler (Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.box ↑n ⋯)) Filter.atTop
  (nhds Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawGraphDefect)

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawEuler_nonclosability_witness
type:
∃ f,
  Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(f n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawEuler (f n)) Filter.atTop
        (nhds Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawGraphDefect) ∧
      Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawGraphDefect ≠ 0

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawEulerGraph
type: Set (↥Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.Hilbert × ↥Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.Hilbert)

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawEuler_graphClosure_defect
type: (0, Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawGraphDefect) ∈ closure Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawEulerGraph

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawEuler_graphClosure_not_singleValued
type:
¬∀ p ∈ closure Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawEulerGraph,
    ∀ q ∈ closure Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawEulerGraph, p.1 = q.1 → p.2 = q.2

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawEuler_graphClosure_not_linearGraph
type: ¬∃ T, ∀ p ∈ closure Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawEulerGraph, T p.1 = p.2

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawEuler_no_bounded_extension
type: ¬∃ T, ∀ (f : ↥Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.compactSupport), T ↑f = Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawEuler f

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.shiftFamily
type: Riemann.Analysis.StrongContractionFamily MeasureTheory.volume ↥Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.Hilbert

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.volterraKernel
type: ℝ → ℝ → ℂ

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.integrable_volterraKernel
type: ∀ {b : ℝ}, 0 < b → MeasureTheory.Integrable (Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.volterraKernel b) MeasureTheory.volume

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.volterraKernelL1
type: ℝ → ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 1 MeasureTheory.volume)

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.volterraKernelL1_ae
type:
∀ {b : ℝ},
  0 < b →
    ↑↑(Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.volterraKernelL1 b) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume] Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.volterraKernel b

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.norm_volterraKernelL1
type: ∀ {b : ℝ}, 0 < b → ‖Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.volterraKernelL1 b‖ = b⁻¹

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.volterra
type: ℝ → ↥Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.Hilbert →L[ℂ] ↥Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.Hilbert

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.norm_volterra_le
type: ∀ {b : ℝ}, 0 < b → ‖Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.volterra b‖ ≤ b⁻¹

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.integrable_volterra_orbit
type:
∀ {b : ℝ},
  0 < b →
    ∀ (f : ↥Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.Hilbert),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun y => Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.volterraKernel b y • (Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.shift y) f)
        MeasureTheory.volume

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.volterra_apply
type:
∀ {b : ℝ},
  0 < b →
    ∀ (f : ↥Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.Hilbert),
      (Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.volterra b) f =
        ∫ (y : ℝ) in Set.Ici 0, ↑(Real.exp (-b * y)) • (Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.shift y) f

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.volterra_finiteInclusion
type:
∀ (L : ℝ),
  0 ≤ L →
    ∀ {b : ℝ},
      0 < b →
        ∀ (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
          (Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.volterra b) ((Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.finiteInclusion L) f) =
            (Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.finiteInclusion L) ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L ↑b) f)

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.operator_ext_finite
type:
∀ {T U : ↥Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.Hilbert →L[ℂ] ↥Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.Hilbert},
  (∀ (L : ℝ),
      0 < L →
        ∀ (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
          T ((Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.finiteInclusion L) f) = U ((Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.finiteInclusion L) f)) →
    T = U

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.volterra_resolvent_identity
type:
∀ {b c : ℝ},
  0 < b →
    0 < c →
      Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.volterra b - Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.volterra c =
        ↑(c - b) • Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.volterra b ∘SL Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.volterra c

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.volterra_commute
type:
∀ {b c : ℝ},
  0 < b →
    0 < c →
      Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.volterra b ∘SL Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.volterra c =
        Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.volterra c ∘SL Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.volterra b

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.factorial_primeFactors_eq_primesBelow
type: ∀ (X : ℕ), X.factorial.primeFactors = (X + 1).primesBelow

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.sum_factorial_divisors_eq_Ioc
type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (X : ℕ) (w : ℕ →*₀ R),
  (∀ (n : ℕ), X < n → w n = 0) → ∑ n ∈ X.factorial.divisors, w n = ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 X, w n

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.nonzero_prime_power_support
type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (X : ℕ) (w : ℕ →*₀ R),
  (∀ (n : ℕ), X < n → w n = 0) → ∀ {p k : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → w p ^ k ≠ 0 → k ≤ X ∧ k ≤ X.factorial.factorization p

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.prime_geometric_sum_eq_range
type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (X : ℕ) (w : ℕ →*₀ R),
  (∀ (n : ℕ), X < n → w n = 0) →
    ∀ {p : ℕ},
      Nat.Prime p → ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (X.factorial.factorization p + 1), w p ^ k = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (X + 1), w p ^ k

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.multiplicativeCoefficients
type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : CommRing R] → (ℕ →*₀ R) → ArithmeticFunction R

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.multiplicativeCoefficients_isMultiplicative
type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (w : ℕ →*₀ R), (Riemann.Arithmetic.multiplicativeCoefficients w).IsMultiplicative

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.divisorSum_eulerFactorization
type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (w : ℕ →*₀ R) {M : ℕ},
  M ≠ 0 → ∑ n ∈ M.divisors, w n = ∏ p ∈ M.primeFactors, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (M.factorization p + 1), w p ^ k

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.primeWeight_pow_eq_zero
type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (w : ℕ →*₀ R) (X : ℕ),
  (∀ (n : ℕ), X < n → w n = 0) → ∀ {p : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → w p ^ (X + 1) = 0

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.primeEulerFactor_left_inverse
type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (w : ℕ →*₀ R) (X : ℕ),
  (∀ (n : ℕ), X < n → w n = 0) → ∀ {p : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (X + 1), w p ^ k) * (1 - w p) = 1

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.primeEulerFactor_right_inverse
type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (w : ℕ →*₀ R) (X : ℕ),
  (∀ (n : ℕ), X < n → w n = 0) → ∀ {p : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → (1 - w p) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (X + 1), w p ^ k = 1

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.finiteEuler_factorization
type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (w : ℕ →*₀ R) (X : ℕ),
  (∀ (n : ℕ), X < n → w n = 0) →
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 X, w n = ∏ p ∈ (X + 1).primesBelow, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (X + 1), w p ^ k

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.finiteEuler_denominator_inverse
type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (w : ℕ →*₀ R) (X : ℕ),
  (∀ (n : ℕ), X < n → w n = 0) → (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 X, w n) * ∏ p ∈ (X + 1).primesBelow, (1 - w p) = 1

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.twist
type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : CommRing R] → [Algebra ℝ R] → (ℕ →*₀ R) → ArithmeticFunction ℝ → ArithmeticFunction R

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.twist_apply
type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Algebra ℝ R] (w : ℕ →*₀ R) (f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (n : ℕ),
  (Riemann.Arithmetic.twist w f) n = (algebraMap ℝ R) (f n) * w n

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.twist_mul
type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Algebra ℝ R] (w : ℕ →*₀ R) (f g : ArithmeticFunction ℝ),
  Riemann.Arithmetic.twist w (f * g) = Riemann.Arithmetic.twist w f * Riemann.Arithmetic.twist w g

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.synthesis
type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : CommRing R] → [Algebra ℝ R] → ℕ → (ℕ →*₀ R) → ArithmeticFunction ℝ → R

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.synthesis_mul
type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Algebra ℝ R] (X : ℕ) (w : ℕ →*₀ R),
  (∀ (n : ℕ), X < n → w n = 0) →
    ∀ (f g : ArithmeticFunction ℝ),
      Riemann.Arithmetic.synthesis X w (f * g) = Riemann.Arithmetic.synthesis X w f * Riemann.Arithmetic.synthesis X w g

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.synthesis_one
type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Algebra ℝ R] (X : ℕ),
  1 ≤ X → ∀ (w : ℕ →*₀ R), Riemann.Arithmetic.synthesis X w 1 = 1

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.synthesis_neg
type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Algebra ℝ R] (X : ℕ) (w : ℕ →*₀ R) (f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ),
  Riemann.Arithmetic.synthesis X w (-f) = -Riemann.Arithmetic.synthesis X w f

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.eulerSynthesis
type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : CommRing R] → [Algebra ℝ R] → ℕ → (ℕ →*₀ R) → R

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.moebiusInverse
type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : CommRing R] → [Algebra ℝ R] → ℕ → (ℕ →*₀ R) → R

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.eulerSynthesis_sum
type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Algebra ℝ R] (X : ℕ) (w : ℕ →*₀ R),
  Riemann.Arithmetic.eulerSynthesis X w = ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 X, w n

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.moebiusInverse_mul_eulerSynthesis
type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Algebra ℝ R] (X : ℕ),
  1 ≤ X →
    ∀ (w : ℕ →*₀ R),
      (∀ (n : ℕ), X < n → w n = 0) → Riemann.Arithmetic.moebiusInverse X w * Riemann.Arithmetic.eulerSynthesis X w = 1

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.eulerSynthesis_mul_moebiusInverse
type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Algebra ℝ R] (X : ℕ),
  1 ≤ X →
    ∀ (w : ℕ →*₀ R),
      (∀ (n : ℕ), X < n → w n = 0) → Riemann.Arithmetic.eulerSynthesis X w * Riemann.Arithmetic.moebiusInverse X w = 1

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.eulerUnit
type:
{R : Type u_1} →
  [inst : CommRing R] → [Algebra ℝ R] → (X : ℕ) → 1 ≤ X → (w : ℕ →*₀ R) → (∀ (n : ℕ), X < n → w n = 0) → Rˣ

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.eulerCoefficientDerivative
type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : CommRing R] → [Algebra ℝ R] → ℕ → (ℕ →*₀ R) → R

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.logarithmicCurrent
type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Algebra ℝ R] (X : ℕ) (w : ℕ →*₀ R),
  (∀ (n : ℕ), X < n → w n = 0) →
    -(Riemann.Arithmetic.moebiusInverse X w * Riemann.Arithmetic.eulerCoefficientDerivative X w) =
      Riemann.Arithmetic.synthesis X w ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.Window
type: ℝ → Set ℝ

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.WindowFunctions
type: ℝ → Type

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.killedShift
type: (L : ℝ) → NNReal → Module.End ℂ (Riemann.Arithmetic.WindowFunctions L)

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.killedShift_apply
type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (y : NNReal) (f : Riemann.Arithmetic.WindowFunctions L) (t : ↑(Riemann.Arithmetic.Window L)),
  (Riemann.Arithmetic.killedShift L y) f t = if h : ↑t + ↑y < L then f ⟨↑t + ↑y, ⋯⟩ else 0

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.killedShift_zero
type: ∀ (L : ℝ), Riemann.Arithmetic.killedShift L 0 = 1

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.killedShift_mul
type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (a b : NNReal),
  Riemann.Arithmetic.killedShift L a * Riemann.Arithmetic.killedShift L b = Riemann.Arithmetic.killedShift L (a + b)

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.killedShift_eq_zero
type: ∀ (L : ℝ) (y : NNReal), L ≤ ↑y → Riemann.Arithmetic.killedShift L y = 0

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.killedShift_commute
type: ∀ (L : ℝ) (a b : NNReal), Commute (Riemann.Arithmetic.killedShift L a) (Riemann.Arithmetic.killedShift L b)

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.coefficientDerivative
type: ArithmeticFunction ℝ → ArithmeticFunction ℝ

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.coefficientDerivative_apply
type: ∀ (f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (n : ℕ), (Riemann.Arithmetic.coefficientDerivative f) n = -Real.log ↑n * f n

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.coefficientDerivative_mul
type:
∀ (f g : ArithmeticFunction ℝ),
  Riemann.Arithmetic.coefficientDerivative (f * g) =
    Riemann.Arithmetic.coefficientDerivative f * g + f * Riemann.Arithmetic.coefficientDerivative g

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.coefficientDerivative_zeta
type: Riemann.Arithmetic.coefficientDerivative ↑ArithmeticFunction.zeta = -ArithmeticFunction.log

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.eulerCoefficientDerivative_eq
type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Algebra ℝ R] (X : ℕ) (w : ℕ →*₀ R),
  Riemann.Arithmetic.eulerCoefficientDerivative X w =
    Riemann.Arithmetic.synthesis X w (Riemann.Arithmetic.coefficientDerivative ↑ArithmeticFunction.zeta)

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.natLog
type: ℕ → NNReal

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.natLog_coe
type: ∀ {n : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → ↑(Riemann.Arithmetic.natLog n) = Real.log ↑n

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.natLog_one
type: Riemann.Arithmetic.natLog 1 = 0

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.natLog_mul
type:
∀ {m n : ℕ},
  m ≠ 0 → n ≠ 0 → Riemann.Arithmetic.natLog (m * n) = Riemann.Arithmetic.natLog m + Riemann.Arithmetic.natLog n

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.multiplicativeShift
type: (L : ℝ) → ℕ →*₀ Module.End ℂ (Riemann.Arithmetic.WindowFunctions L)

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.multiplicativeShift_eq
type:
∀ (L : ℝ) {n : ℕ},
  n ≠ 0 → (Riemann.Arithmetic.multiplicativeShift L) n = Riemann.Arithmetic.killedShift L (Riemann.Arithmetic.natLog n)

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.multiplicativeShift_killed
type: ∀ (L : ℝ) {n : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → L ≤ Real.log ↑n → (Riemann.Arithmetic.multiplicativeShift L) n = 0

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.multiplicativeShift_killed_of_exp_le
type: ∀ (L : ℝ) {n : ℕ}, Real.exp L ≤ ↑n → (Riemann.Arithmetic.multiplicativeShift L) n = 0

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.shiftAlgebra
type: (L : ℝ) → Subalgebra ℂ (Module.End ℂ (Riemann.Arithmetic.WindowFunctions L))

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.shiftCharacter
type: (L : ℝ) → ℕ →*₀ ↥(Riemann.Arithmetic.shiftAlgebra L)

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.shiftCharacter_coe
type: ∀ (L : ℝ) (n : ℕ), ↑((Riemann.Arithmetic.shiftCharacter L) n) = (Riemann.Arithmetic.multiplicativeShift L) n

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.dirichletWeight
type: ℂ → ℕ →*₀ ℂ

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.weightedShift
type: (L : ℝ) → ℂ → ℕ →*₀ ↥(Riemann.Arithmetic.shiftAlgebra L)

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.arithmeticBound
type: ℝ → ℕ

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.arithmeticBound_pos
type: ∀ (L : ℝ), 1 ≤ Riemann.Arithmetic.arithmeticBound L

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.weightedShift_apply
type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (s : ℂ) (n : ℕ),
  (Riemann.Arithmetic.weightedShift L s) n =
    (algebraMap ℂ ↥(Riemann.Arithmetic.shiftAlgebra L)) ((Riemann.Arithmetic.dirichletWeight s) n) *
      (Riemann.Arithmetic.shiftCharacter L) n

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.weightedShift_killed
type: ∀ (L : ℝ) (s : ℂ) {n : ℕ}, Real.exp L ≤ ↑n → (Riemann.Arithmetic.weightedShift L s) n = 0

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.weightedShift_bound
type: ∀ (L : ℝ) (s : ℂ) (n : ℕ), Riemann.Arithmetic.arithmeticBound L < n → (Riemann.Arithmetic.weightedShift L s) n = 0

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.nativeEuler
type: (L : ℝ) → ℂ → ↥(Riemann.Arithmetic.shiftAlgebra L)

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.nativeMoebius
type: (L : ℝ) → ℂ → ↥(Riemann.Arithmetic.shiftAlgebra L)

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.nativeCoefficientDerivative
type: (L : ℝ) → ℂ → ↥(Riemann.Arithmetic.shiftAlgebra L)

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.nativeMangoldtCurrent
type: (L : ℝ) → ℂ → ↥(Riemann.Arithmetic.shiftAlgebra L)

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.nativeEuler_sum
type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (s : ℂ),
  Riemann.Arithmetic.nativeEuler L s =
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 (Riemann.Arithmetic.arithmeticBound L) with ↑n < Real.exp L,
      (Riemann.Arithmetic.weightedShift L s) n

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.nativeMoebius_left_inverse
type: ∀ (L : ℝ) (s : ℂ), Riemann.Arithmetic.nativeMoebius L s * Riemann.Arithmetic.nativeEuler L s = 1

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.nativeMoebius_right_inverse
type: ∀ (L : ℝ) (s : ℂ), Riemann.Arithmetic.nativeEuler L s * Riemann.Arithmetic.nativeMoebius L s = 1

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.native_logarithmicCurrent
type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (s : ℂ),
  -(Riemann.Arithmetic.nativeMoebius L s * Riemann.Arithmetic.nativeCoefficientDerivative L s) =
    Riemann.Arithmetic.nativeMangoldtCurrent L s

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.synthesis_weightedShift_sum
type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (s : ℂ) (a : ArithmeticFunction ℝ),
  Riemann.Arithmetic.synthesis (Riemann.Arithmetic.arithmeticBound L) (Riemann.Arithmetic.weightedShift L s) a =
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 (Riemann.Arithmetic.arithmeticBound L) with ↑n < Real.exp L,
      a n • (Riemann.Arithmetic.weightedShift L s) n

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.nativeMoebius_sum
type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (s : ℂ),
  Riemann.Arithmetic.nativeMoebius L s =
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 (Riemann.Arithmetic.arithmeticBound L) with ↑n < Real.exp L,
      ↑(ArithmeticFunction.moebius n) • (Riemann.Arithmetic.weightedShift L s) n

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.nativeMangoldtCurrent_sum
type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (s : ℂ),
  Riemann.Arithmetic.nativeMangoldtCurrent L s =
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 (Riemann.Arithmetic.arithmeticBound L) with ↑n < Real.exp L,
      ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n • (Riemann.Arithmetic.weightedShift L s) n

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.nativeEuler_apply
type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (s : ℂ) (f : Riemann.Arithmetic.WindowFunctions L) (t : ↑(Riemann.Arithmetic.Window L)),
  ↑(Riemann.Arithmetic.nativeEuler L s) f t =
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 (Riemann.Arithmetic.arithmeticBound L) with ↑n < Real.exp L,
      Complex.exp (-s * ↑(Real.log ↑n)) * (Riemann.Arithmetic.killedShift L (Riemann.Arithmetic.natLog n)) f t

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.nativePrimeFactor
type: (L : ℝ) → ℂ → ℕ → ↥(Riemann.Arithmetic.shiftAlgebra L)

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.nativePrimeFactor_left_inverse
type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (s : ℂ) {p : ℕ},
  Nat.Prime p → Riemann.Arithmetic.nativePrimeFactor L s p * (1 - (Riemann.Arithmetic.weightedShift L s) p) = 1

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.nativePrimeFactor_right_inverse
type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (s : ℂ) {p : ℕ},
  Nat.Prime p → (1 - (Riemann.Arithmetic.weightedShift L s) p) * Riemann.Arithmetic.nativePrimeFactor L s p = 1

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.nativePrimeFactor_sum
type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (s : ℂ) (p : ℕ),
  Riemann.Arithmetic.nativePrimeFactor L s p =
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (Riemann.Arithmetic.arithmeticBound L + 1) with ↑p ^ k < Real.exp L,
      (Riemann.Arithmetic.weightedShift L s) (p ^ k)

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.nativePrimeFactor_eq_one
type: ∀ (L : ℝ) (s : ℂ) {p : ℕ}, Real.exp L ≤ ↑p → Riemann.Arithmetic.nativePrimeFactor L s p = 1

name: Riemann.Arithmetic.nativeEuler_factorization
type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (s : ℂ),
  Riemann.Arithmetic.nativeEuler L s =
    ∏ p ∈ (Riemann.Arithmetic.arithmeticBound L + 1).primesBelow with ↑p < Real.exp L,
      Riemann.Arithmetic.nativePrimeFactor L s p

name: Riemann.Basic.complexSinc
type: ℂ → ℂ

name: Riemann.Basic.complexSinc_zero
type: Riemann.Basic.complexSinc 0 = 1

name: Riemann.Basic.complexSinc_of_ne_zero
type: ∀ {w : ℂ}, w ≠ 0 → Riemann.Basic.complexSinc w = Complex.sin w / w

name: Riemann.Basic.mul_complexSinc
type: ∀ (w : ℂ), w * Riemann.Basic.complexSinc w = Complex.sin w

name: Riemann.Basic.complexSinc_eq_dslope
type: Riemann.Basic.complexSinc = dslope Complex.sin 0

name: Riemann.Basic.differentiable_complexSinc
type: Differentiable ℂ Riemann.Basic.complexSinc

name: Riemann.Basic.complexSinc_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero
type: ∀ {w : ℂ}, w.im ≠ 0 → Riemann.Basic.complexSinc w ≠ 0

name: Riemann.Basic.complexSinc_int_mul_pi
type: ∀ (k : ℤ), Riemann.Basic.complexSinc (↑k * ↑Real.pi) = if k = 0 then 1 else 0

name: Riemann.Basic.complex_sin_add_int_mul_pi
type: ∀ (w : ℂ) (k : ℤ), Complex.sin (w + ↑k * ↑Real.pi) = (-1) ^ k * Complex.sin w

name: Riemann.Basic.complex_sin_sub_int_mul_pi
type: ∀ (w : ℂ) (k : ℤ), Complex.sin (w - ↑k * ↑Real.pi) = (-1) ^ k * Complex.sin w

name: Riemann.Basic.columnRow
type: {ι : Type u_1} → (ι → ℂ) → (ι → ℂ) → Matrix ι ι ℂ

name: Riemann.Basic.columnRow_eq
type: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (u δ : ι → ℂ), Riemann.Basic.columnRow u δ = Matrix.replicateCol Unit u * Matrix.replicateRow Unit δ

name: Riemann.Basic.determinant_add_columnRow
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ),
  A.det ≠ 0 → ∀ (u δ : ι → ℂ), (A + Riemann.Basic.columnRow u δ).det = A.det * (1 + δ ⬝ᵥ A⁻¹.mulVec u)

name: Riemann.Basic.determinant_sub_columnRow
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ),
  A.det ≠ 0 → ∀ (u δ : ι → ℂ), (A - Riemann.Basic.columnRow u δ).det = A.det * (1 - δ ⬝ᵥ A⁻¹.mulVec u)

name: Riemann.Basic.correctedMatrix
type: {ι : Type u_1} → [Fintype ι] → Matrix ι ι ℂ → (ι → ℂ) → (ι → ℂ) → Matrix ι ι ℂ

name: Riemann.Basic.correctedMatrix_determinant_ratio
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (D : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (v δ : ι → ℂ),
  δ ⬝ᵥ v = 1 →
    ∀ (z : ℂ),
      (D - z • 1).det ≠ 0 →
        (Riemann.Basic.correctedMatrix D v δ - z • 1).det / (D - z • 1).det = -z * δ ⬝ᵥ (D - z • 1)⁻¹.mulVec v

name: Riemann.Basic.inner_error_energy
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  (G : E →L[ℂ] E),
  ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint G = G → ∀ (v p : E), G v = 0 → inner ℂ p (G p) = inner ℂ (v - p) (G (v - p))

name: Riemann.Basic.error_energy
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  (G : E →L[ℂ] E),
  ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint G = G → ∀ (v p : E), G v = 0 → (inner ℂ p (G p)).re = (inner ℂ (v - p) (G (v - p))).re

name: Riemann.Basic.hasDerivAt_operator_sum
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℂ E] {ι : Type u_2} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℝ → ℂ)
  (f' : ι → ℂ) (T : ι → E →L[ℂ] E) (σ : ℝ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, HasDerivAt (f i) (f' i) σ) → HasDerivAt (fun t => ∑ i ∈ s, f i t • T i) (∑ i ∈ s, f' i • T i) σ

name: Riemann.Basic.hasDerivAt_operator_mul
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℂ E] {F G : ℝ → E →L[ℂ] E} {F' G' : E →L[ℂ] E}
  {σ : ℝ}, HasDerivAt F F' σ → HasDerivAt G G' σ → HasDerivAt (fun s => F s * G s) (F' * G σ + F σ * G') σ

name: Riemann.Basic.hasDerivAt_operator_affine
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℂ E] (T : E →L[ℂ] E) (c : ℂ) (σ : ℝ),
  HasDerivAt (fun s => 1 + (↑s - c) • T) T σ

name: Riemann.Basic.hasDerivAt_L1_of_dominated_lip
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace α] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace ℝ E] (F : ℝ → ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp E 1 μ)) (g : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp E 1 μ)) (f : ℝ → α → E)
  (g₀ : α → E) (x₀ : ℝ) (s : Set ℝ) (b : α → ℝ),
  s ∈ nhds x₀ →
    (∀ x ∈ s, ↑↑(F x) =ᵐ[μ] f x) →
      ↑↑g =ᵐ[μ] g₀ →
        MeasureTheory.Integrable b μ →
          (∀ᵐ (a : α) ∂μ, 0 ≤ b a) →
            (∀ᵐ (a : α) ∂μ, ∀ x ∈ s, ‖f x a - f x₀ a‖ ≤ b a * ‖x - x₀‖) →
              (∀ᵐ (a : α) ∂μ, HasDerivAt (fun x => f x a) (g₀ a) x₀) → HasDerivAt F g x₀

name: Riemann.Basic.hasDerivAt_L1_of_dominated_deriv
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace α] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace ℝ E] (F : ℝ → ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp E 1 μ)) (g : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp E 1 μ)) (f f₁ : ℝ → α → E)
  (x₀ : ℝ) (s : Set ℝ) (b : α → ℝ),
  s ∈ nhds x₀ →
    Convex ℝ s →
      (∀ x ∈ s, ↑↑(F x) =ᵐ[μ] f x) →
        ↑↑g =ᵐ[μ] f₁ x₀ →
          MeasureTheory.Integrable b μ →
            (∀ᵐ (a : α) ∂μ, 0 ≤ b a) →
              (∀ᵐ (a : α) ∂μ, ∀ x ∈ s, ‖f₁ x a‖ ≤ b a) →
                (∀ᵐ (a : α) ∂μ, ∀ x ∈ s, HasDerivAt (fun x => f x a) (f₁ x a) x) → HasDerivAt F g x₀

name: Riemann.Analysis.integral_L2_ae
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace T] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure T} [MeasureTheory.SFinite μ] [MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite ν]
  {F : Ω → ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 ν)} {φ : Ω → T → ℂ},
  MeasureTheory.Integrable F μ →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable (Function.uncurry φ) (μ.prod ν) →
      (∀ᵐ (y : Ω) ∂μ, ↑↑(F y) =ᵐ[ν] φ y) → ↑↑(∫ (y : Ω), F y ∂μ) =ᵐ[ν] fun t => ∫ (y : Ω), φ y t ∂μ

name: Riemann.Basic.hasDerivAt_matrixPencil
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (s : ℝ),
  HasDerivAt (fun t => A + t • B) B s

name: Riemann.Basic.hasDerivAt_inverseMatrixPencil
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (s : ℝ),
  IsUnit (A + s • B) → HasDerivAt (fun t => (A + t • B)⁻¹) (-((A + s • B)⁻¹ * B * (A + s • B)⁻¹)) s

name: Riemann.Basic.matrixContraction
type: {ι : Type u_1} → [inst : Fintype ι] → [DecidableEq ι] → (ι → ℝ) → (ι → ℝ) → Matrix ι ι ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ

name: Riemann.Basic.matrixContraction_apply
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (x y : ι → ℝ) (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ),
  (Riemann.Basic.matrixContraction x y) M = x ⬝ᵥ M.mulVec y

name: Riemann.Basic.hasDerivAt_inverseContraction
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (s : ℝ),
  IsUnit (A + s • B) →
    ∀ (x y : ι → ℝ),
      HasDerivAt (fun t => x ⬝ᵥ (A + t • B)⁻¹.mulVec y) (-(x ⬝ᵥ ((A + s • B)⁻¹ * B * (A + s • B)⁻¹).mulVec y)) s

name: Riemann.Basic.hasDerivAt_doubleInverseContraction
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (A B C : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (s : ℝ),
  IsUnit (A + s • B) →
    ∀ (x y : ι → ℝ),
      HasDerivAt (fun t => x ⬝ᵥ ((A + t • B)⁻¹ * C * (A + t • B)⁻¹).mulVec y)
        (x ⬝ᵥ
          (-((A + s • B)⁻¹ * B * (A + s • B)⁻¹) * C * (A + s • B)⁻¹ +
                (A + s • B)⁻¹ * C * -((A + s • B)⁻¹ * B * (A + s • B)⁻¹)).mulVec
            y)
        s

name: Riemann.Basic.continuousAt_tripleInverseContraction
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (A B C D : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (s : ℝ),
  IsUnit (A + s • B) →
    ∀ (x y : ι → ℝ), ContinuousAt (fun t => x ⬝ᵥ ((A + t • B)⁻¹ * C * (A + t • B)⁻¹ * D * (A + t • B)⁻¹).mulVec y) s

name: Riemann.positive_energy_eq_zero_iff
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [CompleteSpace E] (G : E →L[ℂ] E),
  G.IsPositive → ∀ (x : E), (inner ℂ x (G x)).re = 0 ↔ G x = 0

name: Riemann.positive_energy_pos
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [CompleteSpace E] (G : E →L[ℂ] E),
  G.IsPositive → ∀ {x : E}, G x ≠ 0 → 0 < (inner ℂ x (G x)).re

name: Riemann.positive_energy_pos_on_kernel_orthogonal
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [CompleteSpace E] (G : E →L[ℂ] E),
  G.IsPositive → ∀ {x : E}, x ∈ (↑G).kerᗮ → x ≠ 0 → 0 < (inner ℂ x (G x)).re

name: Riemann.metricSymmetric_eigenvalue_real
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [CompleteSpace E] (G B : E →L[ℂ] E),
  G.IsPositive →
    (∀ (x y : E), inner ℂ (B x) (G y) = inner ℂ x (G (B y))) →
      (∀ (x : E), G x = 0 → B x = 0) → ∀ {x : E} {z : ℂ}, x ≠ 0 → B x = z • x → z.im = 0

        [FiniteDimensional ℂ E] →
          [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] →
            [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] → [FiniteDimensional ℂ F] → (F →L[ℂ] E) → F →L[ℂ] F

name: Riemann.Basic.columnMass_positive
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (Z : F →L[ℂ] E),
  Function.Injective ⇑Z → ∀ (x : F), x ≠ 0 → 0 < (inner ℂ x ((Riemann.Basic.columnMass Z) x)).re

name: Riemann.Basic.columnMass_nonneg
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (Z : F →L[ℂ] E), 0 ≤ Riemann.Basic.columnMass Z

name: Riemann.Basic.columnMassSqrt
type:
{E : Type u_1} →
  {F : Type u_2} →
    [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] →
      [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] →
        [FiniteDimensional ℂ E] →
          [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] →
            [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] → [FiniteDimensional ℂ F] → (F →L[ℂ] E) → F →L[ℂ] F

name: Riemann.Basic.columnMassSqrt_square
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (Z : F →L[ℂ] E),
  Riemann.Basic.columnMassSqrt Z ∘SL Riemann.Basic.columnMassSqrt Z = Riemann.Basic.columnMass Z

name: Riemann.Basic.columnMassSqrt_adjoint
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (Z : F →L[ℂ] E),
  ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Riemann.Basic.columnMassSqrt Z) = Riemann.Basic.columnMassSqrt Z

name: Riemann.Basic.columnMassSqrt_injective
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (Z : F →L[ℂ] E),
  Function.Injective ⇑Z → Function.Injective ⇑(Riemann.Basic.columnMassSqrt Z)

name: Riemann.Basic.columnMassSqrtEquiv
type:
{E : Type u_1} →
  {F : Type u_2} →
    [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] →
      [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] →
        [FiniteDimensional ℂ E] →
          [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] →
            [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] →
              [FiniteDimensional ℂ F] → (Z : F →L[ℂ] E) → Function.Injective ⇑Z → F ≃L[ℂ] F

name: Riemann.Basic.columnMassSqrtEquiv_apply
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (Z : F →L[ℂ] E) (hZ : Function.Injective ⇑Z) (x : F),
  (Riemann.Basic.columnMassSqrtEquiv Z hZ) x = (Riemann.Basic.columnMassSqrt Z) x

name: Riemann.Basic.whitenedColumns
type:
{E : Type u_1} →
  {F : Type u_2} →
    [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] →
      [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] →
        [FiniteDimensional ℂ E] →
          [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] →
            [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] →
              [FiniteDimensional ℂ F] → (Z : F →L[ℂ] E) → Function.Injective ⇑Z → F →L[ℂ] E

name: Riemann.Basic.whitenedColumns_inner
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (Z : F →L[ℂ] E) (hZ : Function.Injective ⇑Z) (x y : F),
  inner ℂ ((Riemann.Basic.whitenedColumns Z hZ) x) ((Riemann.Basic.whitenedColumns Z hZ) y) = inner ℂ x y

name: Riemann.Basic.whitenedColumns_reconstruct
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (Z : F →L[ℂ] E) (hZ : Function.Injective ⇑Z),
  Riemann.Basic.whitenedColumns Z hZ ∘SL Riemann.Basic.columnMassSqrt Z = Z

name: Riemann.Basic.raw_whitened_congruence
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (Z : F →L[ℂ] E) (hZ : Function.Injective ⇑Z) (H : E →L[ℂ] E),
  Riemann.Basic.galerkinGram H Z =
    Riemann.Basic.columnMassSqrt Z ∘SL
      Riemann.Basic.galerkinGram H (Riemann.Basic.whitenedColumns Z hZ) ∘SL Riemann.Basic.columnMassSqrt Z

name: Riemann.Basic.raw_physical_pencil
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (Z : F →L[ℂ] E) (H : E →L[ℂ] E) (e : ℂ),
  Riemann.Basic.galerkinGram (H - e • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ E) Z =
    Riemann.Basic.galerkinGram H Z - e • Riemann.Basic.columnMass Z

name: Riemann.Basic.whitenedIsometry
type:
{E : Type u_1} →
  {F : Type u_2} →
    [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] →
      [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] →
        [FiniteDimensional ℂ E] →
          [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] →
            [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] →
              [FiniteDimensional ℂ F] → (Z : F →L[ℂ] E) → Function.Injective ⇑Z → F →ₗᵢ[ℂ] E

name: Riemann.Basic.raw_short_whitened
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] {W : Type u_3} [inst_6 : NormedAddCommGroup W] [inst_7 : InnerProductSpace ℂ W]
  [inst_8 : FiniteDimensional ℂ W] (Z : F →L[ℂ] E) (hZ : Function.Injective ⇑Z) (H : E →L[ℂ] E) (J : F →L[ℂ] W)
  (Cinv : W →L[ℂ] W),
  Riemann.Basic.galerkinGram H Z - Riemann.Basic.galerkinGram Cinv J =
    Riemann.Basic.columnMassSqrt Z ∘SL
      (Riemann.Basic.galerkinGram H (Riemann.Basic.whitenedColumns Z hZ) -
          Riemann.Basic.galerkinGram Cinv (J ∘SL ↑(Riemann.Basic.columnMassSqrtEquiv Z hZ).symm)) ∘SL
        Riemann.Basic.columnMassSqrt Z

name: Riemann.Basic.physicalCompression
type:
{E : Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] →
    [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] → [FiniteDimensional ℂ E] → (V : Submodule ℂ E) → (E →L[ℂ] E) → ↥V →L[ℂ] ↥V

name: Riemann.Basic.physicalCompression_inner
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E]
  (V : Submodule ℂ E) (H : E →L[ℂ] E) (x y : ↥V),
  inner ℂ x ((Riemann.Basic.physicalCompression V H) y) = inner ℂ (↑x) (H ↑y)

name: Riemann.Basic.physicalCompression_positive
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E]
  (V : Submodule ℂ E) (H : E →L[ℂ] E),
  (∀ (x : E), x ≠ 0 → 0 < (inner ℂ x (H x)).re) →
    ∀ (x : ↥V), x ≠ 0 → 0 < (inner ℂ x ((Riemann.Basic.physicalCompression V H) x)).re

name: Riemann.Basic.physicalCompression_symmetric
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E]
  (V : Submodule ℂ E) (H : E →L[ℂ] E), (↑H).IsSymmetric → (↑(Riemann.Basic.physicalCompression V H)).IsSymmetric

name: Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse
type:
{E : Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] →
    [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] →
      [FiniteDimensional ℂ E] → (H : E →L[ℂ] E) → (∀ (x : E), x ≠ 0 → 0 < (inner ℂ x (H x)).re) → E →L[ℂ] E

name: Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse_left
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E]
  (H : E →L[ℂ] E) (hH : ∀ (x : E), x ≠ 0 → 0 < (inner ℂ x (H x)).re) (x : E),
  H ((Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse H hH) x) = x

name: Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse_right
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E]
  (H : E →L[ℂ] E) (hH : ∀ (x : E), x ≠ 0 → 0 < (inner ℂ x (H x)).re) (x : E),
  (Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse H hH) (H x) = x

name: Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse_symmetric
type:

name: Riemann.Basic.hyperplane_inverse_apply
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E]
  (H : E →L[ℂ] E) (hH : ∀ (x : E), x ≠ 0 → 0 < (inner ℂ x (H x)).re),
  (↑H).IsSymmetric →
    ∀ (eta : E),
      eta ≠ 0 →
        ∀ (x : E),
          ↑((Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse (Riemann.Basic.physicalCompression (Riemann.Basic.vectorHyperplane eta) H) ⋯)
                ((Riemann.Basic.vectorHyperplane eta).orthogonalProjectionOnto x)) =
            (Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse H hH) x -
              (inner ℂ eta ((Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse H hH) x) /
                  inner ℂ eta ((Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse H hH) eta)) •
                (Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse H hH) eta

name: Riemann.Basic.hyperplane_inverse_defect
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E]
  (H : E →L[ℂ] E) (hH : ∀ (x : E), x ≠ 0 → 0 < (inner ℂ x (H x)).re),
  (↑H).IsSymmetric →
    ∀ (eta : E),
      eta ≠ 0 →
        Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse H hH -
            (Riemann.Basic.vectorHyperplane eta).subtypeL ∘SL
              Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse (Riemann.Basic.physicalCompression (Riemann.Basic.vectorHyperplane eta) H)
                  ⋯ ∘SL
                (Riemann.Basic.vectorHyperplane eta).orthogonalProjectionOnto =
          (inner ℂ eta ((Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse H hH) eta))⁻¹ •
            ((InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ) ((Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse H hH) eta))
              ((Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse H hH) eta)

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]

  (hZ : Function.Injective ⇑Z) (c : E), (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Z) (Riemann.Basic.galerkinResidual Q Z hQ hZ c) = 0

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]

  (hZ : Function.Injective ⇑Z) (c : E) (a : F),
  inner ℂ (Z a) (Q ((Riemann.Basic.strictlyPositiveEquiv Q hQ).symm c - Riemann.Basic.galerkinResponse Q Z hQ hZ c)) = 0

name: Riemann.Basic.positiveGalerkin_decomposition
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (Q : E →L[ℂ] E) (Z : F →L[ℂ] E) (hQ : ∀ (x : E), x ≠ 0 → 0 < (inner ℂ x (Q x)).re)
  (hZ : Function.Injective ⇑Z) (c : E),
  (Riemann.Basic.strictlyPositiveEquiv Q hQ).symm c =
    Riemann.Basic.galerkinResponse Q Z hQ hZ c +
      (Riemann.Basic.strictlyPositiveEquiv Q hQ).symm (Riemann.Basic.galerkinResidual Q Z hQ hZ c)

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]

  (hZ : Function.Injective ⇑Z) (c : E) (ell : E →L[ℂ] ℂ),
  ell ((Riemann.Basic.strictlyPositiveEquiv Q hQ).symm c) =
    ell (Riemann.Basic.galerkinResponse Q Z hQ hZ c) +
      ell ((Riemann.Basic.strictlyPositiveEquiv Q hQ).symm (Riemann.Basic.galerkinResidual Q Z hQ hZ c))

∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]

  (hZ : Function.Injective ⇑Z) (a : F), Riemann.Basic.galerkinResponse Q Z hQ hZ (Q (Z a)) = Z a

name: Riemann.Basic.positiveGalerkin_inner_observation
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (Q : E →L[ℂ] E) (Z : F →L[ℂ] E) (hQ : ∀ (x : E), x ≠ 0 → 0 < (inner ℂ x (Q x)).re)
  (hZ : Function.Injective ⇑Z) (c w : E),
  inner ℂ w ((Riemann.Basic.strictlyPositiveEquiv Q hQ).symm c) =
    inner ℂ ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Z) w)
        ((Riemann.Basic.galerkinGramEquiv Q Z hQ hZ).symm ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Z) c)) +
      inner ℂ w ((Riemann.Basic.strictlyPositiveEquiv Q hQ).symm (Riemann.Basic.galerkinResidual Q Z hQ hZ c))

name: Riemann.Basic.positiveGalerkin_energy
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (Q : E →L[ℂ] E) (Z : F →L[ℂ] E) (hQ : ∀ (x : E), x ≠ 0 → 0 < (inner ℂ x (Q x)).re)
  (hZ : Function.Injective ⇑Z),
  ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q = Q →
    ∀ (c : E),
      inner ℂ c ((Riemann.Basic.strictlyPositiveEquiv Q hQ).symm c) =
        inner ℂ ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Z) c)
            ((Riemann.Basic.galerkinGramEquiv Q Z hQ hZ).symm ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Z) c)) +
          inner ℂ (Riemann.Basic.galerkinResidual Q Z hQ hZ c)
            ((Riemann.Basic.strictlyPositiveEquiv Q hQ).symm (Riemann.Basic.galerkinResidual Q Z hQ hZ c))

name: Riemann.Basic.positivePair_diagonalization
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (K B : Matrix ι ι ℝ),
  K.PosDef →
    B.PosDef →
      ∃ T lambda, IsUnit T ∧ (∀ (i : ι), 0 < lambda i) ∧ star T * B * T = 1 ∧ star T * K * T = Matrix.diagonal lambda

name: Riemann.Basic.positivePair_spectral_representation
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (K B : Matrix ι ι ℝ),
  K.PosDef →
    B.PosDef →
      ∃ lambda,
        (∀ (i : ι), 0 < lambda i) ∧
          (∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < s → ((K + s • B)⁻¹ * B).trace = ∑ i, (lambda i + s)⁻¹) ∧
            ∀ (a b : ℝ), 0 < a → 0 < b → (K + b • B).det / (K + a • B).det = ∏ i, (lambda i + b) / (lambda i + a)

  (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E) (f : E),
  f - ↑(M.boundaryInverse (M.boundaryProjection (M.shifted f))) = inner ℂ M.eta f • M.groundVector

∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E) (x : ↥M.boundaryHyperplane),
  M.boundaryInverse x = (Riemann.Basic.strictlyPositiveEquiv M.boundaryCompression ⋯).symm x

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.boundaryResponse_schur
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {U : Type u_2} {W : Type u_3} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup U] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ U]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ U] [inst_6 : NormedAddCommGroup W] [inst_7 : InnerProductSpace ℂ W]
  [inst_8 : FiniteDimensional ℂ W] (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E) (S : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Data U W)
  (e : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U W ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] ↥M.boundaryHyperplane),
  (∀ (z : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U W),
      M.boundaryCompression (e z) = e ((Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.block S.A S.B S.C) z)) →
    M.boundaryResponse =
      e (S.solution (WithLp.fst (e.symm M.boundaryCoupling)) (WithLp.snd (e.symm M.boundaryCoupling)))

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.groundVector_schur
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {U : Type u_2} {W : Type u_3} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup U] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ U]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ U] [inst_6 : NormedAddCommGroup W] [inst_7 : InnerProductSpace ℂ W]
  [inst_8 : FiniteDimensional ℂ W] (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E) (S : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Data U W)
  (e : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U W ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] ↥M.boundaryHyperplane),
  (∀ (z : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U W),
      M.boundaryCompression (e z) = e ((Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.block S.A S.B S.C) z)) →
    M.groundVector =
      M.boundarySection - ↑(e (WithLp.toLp 2 (0, S.inverseC (WithLp.snd (e.symm M.boundaryCoupling))))) -
        ↑(e
            (S.lift
              (S.inverseShort
                (S.effective (WithLp.fst (e.symm M.boundaryCoupling)) (WithLp.snd (e.symm M.boundaryCoupling))))))

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.boundaryObservation_schur
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {U : Type u_2} {W : Type u_3} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup U] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ U]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ U] [inst_6 : NormedAddCommGroup W] [inst_7 : InnerProductSpace ℂ W]
  [inst_8 : FiniteDimensional ℂ W] (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E) (S : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Data U W)
  (e : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U W ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] ↥M.boundaryHyperplane),
  (∀ (z : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U W),
      M.boundaryCompression (e z) = e ((Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.block S.A S.B S.C) z)) →
    ∀ (ell : E →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ),
      ell M.groundVector =
        ell M.boundarySection - ell ↑(e (WithLp.toLp 2 (0, S.inverseC (WithLp.snd (e.symm M.boundaryCoupling))))) -
          ell
            ↑(e
                (S.lift
                  (S.inverseShort
                    (S.effective (WithLp.fst (e.symm M.boundaryCoupling)) (WithLp.snd (e.symm M.boundaryCoupling))))))

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.boundaryEnergy_schur
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {U : Type u_2} {W : Type u_3} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup U] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ U]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ U] [inst_6 : NormedAddCommGroup W] [inst_7 : InnerProductSpace ℂ W]
  [inst_8 : FiniteDimensional ℂ W] (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E) (S : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Data U W)
  (e : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U W ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] ↥M.boundaryHyperplane),
  (∀ (z : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U W),
      M.boundaryCompression (e z) = e ((Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.block S.A S.B S.C) z)) →
    inner ℂ M.boundaryCoupling M.boundaryResponse =
      inner ℂ (WithLp.snd (e.symm M.boundaryCoupling)) (S.inverseC (WithLp.snd (e.symm M.boundaryCoupling))) +
        inner ℂ (S.effective (WithLp.fst (e.symm M.boundaryCoupling)) (WithLp.snd (e.symm M.boundaryCoupling)))
          (S.inverseShort
            (S.effective (WithLp.fst (e.symm M.boundaryCoupling)) (WithLp.snd (e.symm M.boundaryCoupling))))

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.normalizedBoundaryObservation_schur
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {U : Type u_2} {W : Type u_3} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup U] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ U]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ U] [inst_6 : NormedAddCommGroup W] [inst_7 : InnerProductSpace ℂ W]
  [inst_8 : FiniteDimensional ℂ W] (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E) (S : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Data U W)
  (e : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U W ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] ↥M.boundaryHyperplane),
  (∀ (z : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U W),
      M.boundaryCompression (e z) = e ((Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.block S.A S.B S.C) z)) →
    ∀ (ell anchor : E →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ),
      ell M.groundVector / anchor M.groundVector =
        (ell M.boundarySection -
            ell ↑(e (S.solution (WithLp.fst (e.symm M.boundaryCoupling)) (WithLp.snd (e.symm M.boundaryCoupling))))) /
          (anchor M.boundarySection -
            anchor ↑(e (S.solution (WithLp.fst (e.symm M.boundaryCoupling)) (WithLp.snd (e.symm M.boundaryCoupling)))))

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.schur_anchor_ne_zero
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {U : Type u_2} {W : Type u_3} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup U] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ U]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ U] [inst_6 : NormedAddCommGroup W] [inst_7 : InnerProductSpace ℂ W]
  [inst_8 : FiniteDimensional ℂ W] (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E) (S : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Data U W)
  (e : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U W ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] ↥M.boundaryHyperplane),
  (∀ (z : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U W),
      M.boundaryCompression (e z) = e ((Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.block S.A S.B S.C) z)) →
    ∀ (anchor : E →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ),
      anchor M.groundVector ≠ 0 →
        anchor M.boundarySection -
            anchor ↑(e (S.solution (WithLp.fst (e.symm M.boundaryCoupling)) (WithLp.snd (e.symm M.boundaryCoupling)))) ≠
          0

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.boundaryResponse_schur_transitive
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {U : Type u_2} {W : Type u_3} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup U] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ U]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ U] [inst_6 : NormedAddCommGroup W] [inst_7 : InnerProductSpace ℂ W]
  [inst_8 : FiniteDimensional ℂ W] (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E) {F : Type u_4} [inst_9 : NormedAddCommGroup F]
  [inst_10 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [inst_11 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (T : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.ThreeData U W F)
  (e : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U (Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space W F) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] ↥M.boundaryHyperplane),
  (∀ (z : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U (Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space W F)),
      M.boundaryCompression (e z) = e ((Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.block T.direct.A T.direct.B T.direct.C) z)) →
    M.boundaryResponse =
      e
        (T.successiveSolution (WithLp.fst (e.symm M.boundaryCoupling))
          (WithLp.fst (WithLp.snd (e.symm M.boundaryCoupling))) (WithLp.snd (WithLp.snd (e.symm M.boundaryCoupling))))

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.boundaryObservation_schur_transitive
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {U : Type u_2} {W : Type u_3} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup U] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ U]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ U] [inst_6 : NormedAddCommGroup W] [inst_7 : InnerProductSpace ℂ W]
  [inst_8 : FiniteDimensional ℂ W] (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E) {F : Type u_4} [inst_9 : NormedAddCommGroup F]
  [inst_10 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [inst_11 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (T : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.ThreeData U W F)
  (e : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U (Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space W F) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] ↥M.boundaryHyperplane),
  (∀ (z : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U (Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space W F)),
      M.boundaryCompression (e z) = e ((Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.block T.direct.A T.direct.B T.direct.C) z)) →
    ∀ (ell : E →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ),
      ell M.groundVector =
        ell M.boundarySection -
          ell
            ↑(e
                (T.successiveSolution (WithLp.fst (e.symm M.boundaryCoupling))
                  (WithLp.fst (WithLp.snd (e.symm M.boundaryCoupling)))
                  (WithLp.snd (WithLp.snd (e.symm M.boundaryCoupling)))))

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.boundary_observation
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E) (ell : E →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ),
  ell M.groundVector = ell M.boundarySection - ell ↑M.boundaryResponse

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.boundary_observation_inner
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E) (k : E),
  inner ℂ k M.groundVector =
    inner ℂ k M.boundarySection - inner ℂ (M.boundaryInverse (M.boundaryProjection k)) M.boundaryCoupling

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.normalized_boundary_observation
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E) (ell anchor : E →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ),
  anchor M.groundVector ≠ 0 →
    ell M.groundVector / anchor M.groundVector =
      (ell M.boundarySection - ell ↑M.boundaryResponse) / (anchor M.boundarySection - anchor ↑M.boundaryResponse)

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.boundary_observation_anchor_ne_zero
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E) (anchor : E →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ),
  anchor M.groundVector ≠ 0 → anchor M.boundarySection - anchor ↑M.boundaryResponse ≠ 0

type: {N : ℕ} → ℝ → ℂ → Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.centeredFourierRow_apply
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (L : ℝ) (z : ℂ) (v : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.centeredFourierRow L z) v = Riemann.CCM.Native.centeredFourierObservation L v z

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_fourier_boundary_response
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (z : ℂ),
  Riemann.CCM.Native.centeredFourierObservation L (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).groundVector z =
    Riemann.CCM.Native.centeredFourierObservation L (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).boundarySection z -
      Riemann.CCM.Native.centeredFourierObservation L (↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).boundaryResponse) z

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_fourier_anchor_ne_zero
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C),
  Riemann.CCM.Native.centeredFourierObservation L (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).groundVector (Complex.I / 4) ≠
    0

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_normalized_fourier_boundary_ratio
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (z : ℂ),
  Riemann.CCM.Native.centeredFourierObservation L (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).groundVector z /
      Riemann.CCM.Native.centeredFourierObservation L (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).groundVector
        (Complex.I / 4) =
    (Riemann.CCM.Native.centeredFourierObservation L (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).boundarySection z -
        Riemann.CCM.Native.centeredFourierObservation L (↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).boundaryResponse) z) /
      (Riemann.CCM.Native.centeredFourierObservation L (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).boundarySection
          (Complex.I / 4) -
        Riemann.CCM.Native.centeredFourierObservation L (↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).boundaryResponse)
          (Complex.I / 4))

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_boundary_ratio_denominator_ne_zero
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C),
  Riemann.CCM.Native.centeredFourierObservation L (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).boundarySection
        (Complex.I / 4) -
      Riemann.CCM.Native.centeredFourierObservation L (↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).boundaryResponse)
        (Complex.I / 4) ≠
    0

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.odd_inner_even
type:

type:
{E : Type u_1} →

    [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] → [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] → Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E → E

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.boundary_normalizedGround
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.shifted_normalizedGround
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.reflection_normalizedGround

∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
