name: Riemann.CCM.Native.anchoredBoundaryCharacteristic
type: {N : ℕ} → ℝ → Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.boundarySoftMean
type: {N : ℕ} → ℝ → Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N → ℝ → ℂ

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.boundarySoftMean_eq_logDeriv
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (L : ℝ) (v : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N) (a : ℝ),
  Riemann.CCM.Native.boundarySoftMean L v a =
    Complex.I * ↑a / 2 * logDeriv (Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryCharacteristic L v) (Complex.I * ↑a)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_anchoredBoundaryCharacteristic_anchor
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  {a : ℝ},
  0 < a →
    Riemann.CCM.Native.anchoredBoundaryCharacteristic L (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).groundVector a
        (Complex.I * ↑a) =
      1

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.boundarySoftMean_quarter
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (L : ℝ) (v : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
  Riemann.CCM.Native.boundarySoftMean L v (1 / 4) =
    Complex.I / 8 * deriv (Riemann.CCM.Native.anchoredBoundaryCharacteristic L v (1 / 4)) (Complex.I / 4)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.complexSinc_derivative_identity
type: ∀ (w : ℂ), Riemann.Basic.complexSinc w + w * deriv Riemann.Basic.complexSinc w = Complex.cos w

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.complexSinc_logDeriv
type: ∀ {w : ℂ}, w ≠ 0 → Riemann.Basic.complexSinc w ≠ 0 → w * logDeriv Riemann.Basic.complexSinc w = w * w.cot - 1

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.sinc_slope_eq_latticeTail
type:
∀ {L a : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    0 < a →
      Complex.I * ↑a / 2 * logDeriv (fun z => Riemann.Basic.complexSinc (↑L * z / 2)) (Complex.I * ↑a) =
        ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeTail L 0 (a ^ 2))

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.logDeriv_imaginary_axis
type:
∀ {f : ℂ → ℂ} {a : ℝ},
  DifferentiableAt ℂ f (Complex.I * ↑a) →
    logDeriv (fun t => f (Complex.I * ↑t)) a = Complex.I * logDeriv f (Complex.I * ↑a)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.boundarySoftMean_of_axis_factorization
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData ι) {L a : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    0 < a →
      ∀ (v : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
        Differentiable ℂ (Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryCharacteristic L v) →
          (∀ (t : ℝ),
              0 < t →
                Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryCharacteristic L v (Complex.I * ↑t) =
                  Riemann.Basic.complexSinc (↑L * (Complex.I * ↑t) / 2) * ↑(M.determinantRatio (t ^ 2))) →
            Riemann.CCM.Native.boundarySoftMean L v a =
              ↑(M.highMean (a ^ 2) - M.freeMean (a ^ 2) + Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeTail L 0 (a ^ 2))

name: Riemann.CCM.constantModeExample
type: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData ℂ

name: Riemann.CCM.constantModeExample_ground_eq_constant
type: Riemann.CCM.constantModeExample.ground = Riemann.CCM.constantModeExample.constant

name: Riemann.CCM.constantModeExample_bright
type: inner ℂ Riemann.CCM.constantModeExample.eta Riemann.CCM.constantModeExample.ground ≠ 0

name: Riemann.CCM.constantModeExample_derivative_ground
type: Riemann.CCM.constantModeExample.D Riemann.CCM.constantModeExample.ground = 0

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.corrected
type:
{E : Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] →
    [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] → [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] → Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E → E →L[ℂ] E

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.corrected_apply
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E) (x : E), M.corrected x = M.D x - inner ℂ M.eta x • M.D M.groundVector

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.corrected_ground
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E), M.corrected M.groundVector = 0

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.corrected_on_boundary_kernel
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E) {x : E}, inner ℂ M.eta x = 0 → M.corrected x = M.D x

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.shifted_corrected_apply
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E) (x : E), M.shifted (M.corrected x) = M.shifted (M.D x) + inner ℂ M.eta x • M.b

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.metric_intertwining
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E),
  M.shifted ∘SL M.corrected = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint M.corrected ∘SL M.shifted

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.weighted_symmetry
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E) (x y : E),
  inner ℂ (M.corrected x) (M.shifted y) = inner ℂ x (M.shifted (M.corrected y))

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.corrected_unique
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E) (A : E →L[ℂ] E),
  A M.groundVector = 0 → (∀ (x : E), inner ℂ M.eta x = 0 → A x = M.D x) → A = M.corrected

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.projector_ground
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E) (P : E →L[ℂ] E),
  P ∘SL P = P →
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint P = P →
      P M.ground = M.ground → (↑P).range = ℂ ∙ M.ground → Riemann.Basic.projectorNormalized P M.eta = M.groundVector

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData
type: (E : Type u_1) → [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] → [InnerProductSpace ℂ E] → [CompleteSpace E] → Type u_1

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.shifted
type:
{E : Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] →
    [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] → [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] → Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E → E →L[ℂ] E

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.boundary
type:
{E : Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] →
    [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] → [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] → Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E → E → ℂ

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.shifted_apply
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E) (x : E), M.shifted x = M.H x - ↑M.e₀ • x

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.shifted_ground
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E), M.shifted M.ground = 0

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.shifted_eq_zero_iff
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E) (x : E), M.shifted x = 0 ↔ ∃ a, x = a • M.ground

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.shifted_displacement
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E) (x : E),
  M.D (M.shifted x) - M.shifted (M.D x) = inner ℂ M.eta x • M.b - inner ℂ M.b x • M.eta

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.shifted_nonneg
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E) (x : E), 0 ≤ (inner ℂ x (M.shifted x)).re

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.shifted_selfadjoint
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E), ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint M.shifted = M.shifted

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_characteristic_capacity
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C),
  0 < N →
    ∀ (J : ℕ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a),
      Riemann.CCM.Native.boundarySoftMean L (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).groundVector a =
        ↑((Riemann.CCM.Native.canonicalNativeGraphData C L hL A J).capacityWithLattice (a ^ 2) ⋯
            (Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeTail L N (a ^ 2)))

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_characteristic_capacity_decomposition
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C),
  0 < N →
    ∀ (J : ℕ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a),
      have P := Riemann.CCM.Native.canonicalNativeGraphData C L hL A J;
      Riemann.CCM.Native.boundarySoftMean L (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).groundVector a =
        ↑((Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighPencil C L hL A J).softMean (a ^ 2) ⋯ + P.graphPencil.softMean (a ^ 2) ⋯ +
              P.coupling (a ^ 2) ⋯ +
            Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeTail L N (a ^ 2))

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_characteristic_capacity_bounds
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C),
  0 < N →
    ∀ (J : ℕ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a),
      have P := Riemann.CCM.Native.canonicalNativeGraphData C L hL A J;
      have mu := (Riemann.CCM.Native.boundarySoftMean L (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).groundVector a).re;
      (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighPencil C L hL A J).softMean (a ^ 2) ⋯ + P.graphPencil.softMean (a ^ 2) ⋯ ≤ mu ∧
        mu <
          (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighPencil C L hL A J).softMean (a ^ 2) ⋯ + P.graphPencil.softMean (a ^ 2) ⋯ + 1 +
            Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeTail L N (a ^ 2)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_characteristic_coupling_bounds
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (J : ℕ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a),
  have P := Riemann.CCM.Native.canonicalNativeGraphData C L hL A J;
  0 ≤ P.coupling (a ^ 2) ⋯ ∧ P.coupling (a ^ 2) ⋯ < 1

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_boundarySoftMean_eq_softMean_add_lattice
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C),
  0 < N →
    ∀ {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a),
      Riemann.CCM.Native.boundarySoftMean L (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).groundVector a =
        ↑((Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighPencil C L hL A 0).softMean (a ^ 2) ⋯ +
            Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeTail L N (a ^ 2))

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_boundarySoftMean_im
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C),
  0 < N →
    ∀ {a : ℝ},
      0 < a → (Riemann.CCM.Native.boundarySoftMean L (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).groundVector a).im = 0

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeFrequency
type: ℝ → ℤ → ℝ

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency_eq_lattice
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (L : ℝ) (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
  Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i = Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeFrequency L (Riemann.CCM.Native.mode i)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.half_frequency
type: ∀ {L : ℝ}, 0 < L → ∀ (k : ℤ), ↑L * ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeFrequency L k) / 2 = ↑k * ↑Real.pi

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.shifted_argument
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (z : ℂ) (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
      ↑L * (z - ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i)) / 2 = ↑L * z / 2 - ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.mode i) * ↑Real.pi

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.phased_sinc
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (z : ℂ) (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
      z ≠ ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i) →
        (-1) ^ Riemann.CCM.Native.mode i *
            Riemann.Basic.complexSinc (↑L * (z - ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i)) / 2) =
          2 * Complex.sin (↑L * z / 2) / (↑L * (z - ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i)))

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryCharacteristic
type: {N : ℕ} → ℝ → Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N → ℂ → ℂ

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryCharacteristic_off_lattice
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (L : ℝ) (v : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N) (z : ℂ),
  (∀ (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N), z ≠ ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i)) →
    Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryCharacteristic L v z =
      Riemann.Basic.complexSinc (↑L * z / 2) *
        ((Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryMatrix L v - z • 1).det / (Riemann.CCM.Native.freeMatrix N L - z • 1).det)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryCharacteristic_at_mode
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (v : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N) (j : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
      Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryCharacteristic L v ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L j) =
        (-1) ^ Riemann.CCM.Native.mode j * v.ofLp j / ↑√L

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.sinc_at_lattice
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (k : ℤ) (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
      Riemann.Basic.complexSinc
          (↑L * (↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeFrequency L k) - ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i)) / 2) =
        if Riemann.CCM.Native.mode i = k then 1 else 0

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.centeredFourierObservation_at_mode
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (v : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N) (j : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
      Riemann.CCM.Native.centeredFourierObservation L v ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L j) =
        ↑√L * (v.ofLp j * (-1) ^ Riemann.CCM.Native.mode j)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.centeredFourierObservation_outside
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (v : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N) (k : ℤ),
      (∀ (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N), Riemann.CCM.Native.mode i ≠ k) →
        Riemann.CCM.Native.centeredFourierObservation L v ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeFrequency L k) = 0

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.centeredFourierObservation_resolvent
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (v : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N) (z : ℂ),
      (∀ (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N), z ≠ ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i)) →
        Riemann.CCM.Native.centeredFourierObservation L v z =
          -2 * Complex.sin (↑L * z / 2) * ((↑√L)⁻¹ * ∑ i, v.ofLp i / (↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i) - z))

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryCharacteristic_eq_fourier
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (v : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
      inner ℂ (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpointVector N L) v = 1 →
        ∀ (z : ℂ),
          Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryCharacteristic L v z = Riemann.CCM.Native.centeredFourierObservation L v z / ↑L

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.differentiable_boundaryCharacteristic
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (v : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
      inner ℂ (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpointVector N L) v = 1 →
        Differentiable ℂ (Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryCharacteristic L v)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryCharacteristic_outside
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (v : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
      inner ℂ (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpointVector N L) v = 1 →
        ∀ (k : ℤ),
          (∀ (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N), Riemann.CCM.Native.mode i ≠ k) →
            Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryCharacteristic L v ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeFrequency L k) = 0

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_boundaryCharacteristic_nonreal
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  {z : ℂ},
  z.im ≠ 0 → Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryCharacteristic L (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).groundVector z ≠ 0

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_boundaryCharacteristic_eq_integral
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (z : ℂ),
  Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryCharacteristic L (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).groundVector z =
    (∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..L,
        Riemann.CCM.Native.fourierFunction L (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).groundVector t *
          Complex.exp (-Complex.I * z * (↑t - ↑L / 2))) /
      ↑L

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_boundaryCharacteristic_entire
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C),
  Differentiable ℂ (Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryCharacteristic L (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).groundVector)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_fourierObservation_nonreal
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  {z : ℂ},
  z.im ≠ 0 → Riemann.CCM.Native.centeredFourierObservation L (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).groundVector z ≠ 0

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.centeredFourierObservation
type: {N : ℕ} → ℝ → Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N → ℂ → ℂ

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.differentiable_centeredFourierObservation
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (L : ℝ) (v : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
  Differentiable ℂ (Riemann.CCM.Native.centeredFourierObservation L v)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.integral_symmetric_exp
type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (w : ℂ),
  ∫ (t : ℝ) in -(L / 2)..L / 2, Complex.exp (-Complex.I * w * ↑t) = ↑L * Riemann.Basic.complexSinc (↑L * w / 2)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.integral_centered_exp
type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (w : ℂ),
  ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..L, Complex.exp (-Complex.I * w * (↑t - ↑L / 2)) = ↑L * Riemann.Basic.complexSinc (↑L * w / 2)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency_half_period
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i) * ↑L / 2) = (-1) ^ Riemann.CCM.Native.mode i

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.centered_mode_factor
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N) (z : ℂ) (t : ℝ),
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i) * ↑t)) *
          Complex.exp (-Complex.I * z * (↑t - ↑L / 2)) =
        (-1) ^ Riemann.CCM.Native.mode i *
          Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (z - ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i)) * (↑t - ↑L / 2))

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.integral_fourierFunction_centered
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (v : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N) (z : ℂ),
      ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..L, Riemann.CCM.Native.fourierFunction L v t * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * z * (↑t - ↑L / 2)) =
        Riemann.CCM.Native.centeredFourierObservation L v z

type: (N : ℕ) → ℝ → Matrix (Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N) (Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N) ℂ

type: {N : ℕ} → ℝ → Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N → Matrix (Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N) (Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N) ℂ

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.freeMatrix_sub
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (L : ℝ) (z : ℂ),
  Riemann.CCM.Native.freeMatrix N L - z • 1 = Matrix.diagonal fun i => ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i) - z

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.freeMatrix_det_ne_zero_iff
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (L : ℝ) (z : ℂ),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.freeMatrix N L - z • 1).det ≠ 0 ↔
    ∀ (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N), z ≠ ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.freeMatrix_det_ne_zero_of_nonreal
type: ∀ {N : ℕ} (L : ℝ) {z : ℂ}, z.im ≠ 0 → (Riemann.CCM.Native.freeMatrix N L - z • 1).det ≠ 0

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.endpointRow_dot
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (L : ℝ) (v : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpointRow N L ⬝ᵥ fun i => v.ofLp i) = inner ℂ (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpointVector N L) v

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.freeMatrix_resolvent
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (L : ℝ) (v : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N) (z : ℂ),
  (∀ (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N), z ≠ ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i)) →
    (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpointRow N L ⬝ᵥ (Riemann.CCM.Native.freeMatrix N L - z • 1)⁻¹.mulVec fun i => v.ofLp i) =
      (↑√L)⁻¹ * ∑ i, v.ofLp i / (↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i) - z)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryMatrix_determinant_ratio
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (L : ℝ) (v : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
  inner ℂ (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpointVector N L) v = 1 →
    ∀ (z : ℂ),
      (∀ (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N), z ≠ ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i)) →
        (Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryMatrix L v - z • 1).det / (Riemann.CCM.Native.freeMatrix N L - z • 1).det =
          -z * ((↑√L)⁻¹ * ∑ i, v.ofLp i / (↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i) - z))

type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N) (Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N) ℂ) (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N)

type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData ι) {s : ℝ},

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData ι) {s : ℝ},

name: Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData.logarithmicEnergy_identity
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData ι) {s : ℝ},
  0 < s →
    s * deriv M.determinantRatio s / M.determinantRatio s =
      M.boundaryCorrection s + s / 2 * deriv (fun t => Real.log (M.inverseEnergy t)) s

name: Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData.boundaryCorrection_second_derivative

name: Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData.freeLogRatio
type: {ι : Type u_1} → [inst : Fintype ι] → [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] → Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData ι → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ

name: Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData.pencil_log_ratio_eq
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData ι) {a b : ℝ},
  0 < a →
    0 < b →
      Real.log ((M.pencil b).det / (M.pencil a).det) =
        M.freeLogRatio a b + Real.log (M.determinantRatio b / M.determinantRatio a)

name: Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData.high_spectral_representation
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData ι),
  ∃ lambda,
    (∀ (i : ι), 0 < lambda i) ∧
      (∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < s → M.highMean s = ∑ i, s / (lambda i + s)) ∧
        ∀ (a b : ℝ),
          0 < a →
            0 < b →
              M.freeLogRatio a b + Real.log (M.determinantRatio b / M.determinantRatio a) =
                ∑ i, Real.log ((lambda i + b) / (lambda i + a))

name: Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData.capacity_log_bounds
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData ι) {a b : ℝ},
  0 < a →
    a ≤ b →
      Real.log (b / a) * M.highMean a ≤ M.freeLogRatio a b + Real.log (M.determinantRatio b / M.determinantRatio a) ∧
        M.freeLogRatio a b + Real.log (M.determinantRatio b / M.determinantRatio a) ≤ (b / a - 1) * M.highMean a

name: Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData.capacity_energy_bounds
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData ι) {a b : ℝ},
  0 < a →
    a ≤ b →
      Real.log (b / a) * (M.highMean a - 1) ≤
          M.freeLogRatio a b + 1 / 2 * Real.log (M.inverseEnergy b / M.inverseEnergy a) ∧
        M.freeLogRatio a b + 1 / 2 * Real.log (M.inverseEnergy b / M.inverseEnergy a) ≤ (b / a - 1) * M.highMean a

name: Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData.fixed_anchor_capacity_energy_bounds
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData ι),
  Real.log 9 * (M.highMean (1 / 16) - 1) ≤
      M.freeLogRatio (1 / 16) (9 / 16) + 1 / 2 * Real.log (M.inverseEnergy (9 / 16) / M.inverseEnergy (1 / 16)) ∧
    M.freeLogRatio (1 / 16) (9 / 16) + 1 / 2 * Real.log (M.inverseEnergy (9 / 16) / M.inverseEnergy (1 / 16)) ≤
      8 * M.highMean (1 / 16)

name: Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData.fixed_anchor_capacity_of_energy_ratio
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData ι) {C : ℝ},
  M.inverseEnergy (9 / 16) / M.inverseEnergy (1 / 16) ≤ C →
    M.highMean (1 / 16) ≤ 1 + (M.freeLogRatio (1 / 16) (9 / 16) + 1 / 2 * Real.log C) / Real.log 9

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.odd_pair_resolvent
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (L : ℝ),
  0 < L →
    ∀ (j : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J) {a : ℝ},
      0 < a →
        (↑√L)⁻¹ *
            ∑ i, (Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector j).ofLp i / (↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i) - Complex.I * ↑a) =
          ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealZeta L j / (Riemann.CCM.Native.highFrequency L j ^ 2 + a ^ 2))

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.odd_synthesis_resolvent
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (L : ℝ),
  0 < L →
    ∀ (t : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J → ℝ) {a : ℝ},
      0 < a →
        (↑√L)⁻¹ *
            ∑ i,
              (Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighRealSynthesis t).ofLp i /
                (↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i) - Complex.I * ↑a) =
          ↑(∑ j, t j * (Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealZeta L j / (Riemann.CCM.Native.highFrequency L j ^ 2 + a ^ 2)))

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_full_resolvent_diagonal
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (J : ℕ) (hJN : J < N) {s : ℝ},
  0 < s →
    (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeInverseEnergyData C L hL A J hJN).resolvent s =
      Matrix.diagonal fun j => (Riemann.CCM.Native.highFrequency L j ^ 2 + s)⁻¹

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryMatrix_derivative_ratio
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (L : ℝ) (v : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N) (z : ℂ),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.freeMatrix N L - z • 1).det ≠ 0 →
    (Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryMatrix L v - z • 1).det / (Riemann.CCM.Native.freeMatrix N L - z • 1).det =
      1 -
        Riemann.CCM.Native.endpointRow N L ⬝ᵥ
          (Riemann.CCM.Native.freeMatrix N L - z • 1)⁻¹.mulVec fun i => ((Riemann.CCM.Native.derivative L) v).ofLp i

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_boundary_determinant_inverseEnergy
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (hN : 0 < N) {a : ℝ},
  0 < a →
    have v := (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).groundVector;
    (Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryMatrix L v - (Complex.I * ↑a) • 1).det /
        (Riemann.CCM.Native.freeMatrix N L - (Complex.I * ↑a) • 1).det =
      ↑((Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeInverseEnergyData C L hL A 0 hN).determinantRatio (a ^ 2))

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_characteristic_inverseEnergy
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (hN : 0 < N) {a : ℝ},
  0 < a →
    Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryCharacteristic L (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).groundVector (Complex.I * ↑a) =
      Riemann.Basic.complexSinc (↑L * (Complex.I * ↑a) / 2) *
        ↑((Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeInverseEnergyData C L hL A 0 hN).determinantRatio (a ^ 2))

name: Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData.continuousAt_responseMoment
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData ι) {s : ℝ},
  0 < s → ContinuousAt M.responseMoment s

name: Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData.continuousAt_boundaryCorrection
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData ι) {s : ℝ},
  0 < s → ContinuousAt M.boundaryCorrection s

name: Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData.logarithmicBalance
type: {ι : Type u_1} → [inst : Fintype ι] → [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] → Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData ι → ℝ → ℝ

name: Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData.hasDerivAt_logarithmicBalance
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData ι) {s : ℝ},
  0 < s → HasDerivAt M.logarithmicBalance (M.boundaryCorrection s / s) s

name: Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData.boundaryCorrection_intervalIntegrable
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData ι) {a b : ℝ},
  0 < a → a ≤ b → IntervalIntegrable (fun t => M.boundaryCorrection t / t) MeasureTheory.volume a b

name: Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData.logarithmicBalance_integral
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData ι) {a b : ℝ},
  0 < a → a ≤ b → ∫ (t : ℝ) in a..b, M.boundaryCorrection t / t = M.logarithmicBalance b - M.logarithmicBalance a

name: Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData.log_determinantRatio
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData ι) {a b : ℝ},
  0 < a →
    a ≤ b →
      Real.log (M.determinantRatio b / M.determinantRatio a) =
        1 / 2 * Real.log (M.inverseEnergy b / M.inverseEnergy a) + ∫ (t : ℝ) in a..b, M.boundaryCorrection t / t

name: Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData.boundaryCorrection_integral_bounds
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData ι) {a b : ℝ},
  0 < a →
    a ≤ b →
      0 ≤ ∫ (t : ℝ) in a..b, M.boundaryCorrection t / t ∧
        ∫ (t : ℝ) in a..b, M.boundaryCorrection t / t ≤ Real.log (b / a)

name: Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData.fixed_anchor_log_identity
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData ι),
  Real.log (M.determinantRatio (9 / 16) / M.determinantRatio (1 / 16)) =
    1 / 2 * Real.log (M.inverseEnergy (9 / 16) / M.inverseEnergy (1 / 16)) +
      ∫ (t : ℝ) in 1 / 16..9 / 16, M.boundaryCorrection t / t

name: Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData.fixed_anchor_correction_bounds
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData ι),
  0 ≤ ∫ (t : ℝ) in 1 / 16..9 / 16, M.boundaryCorrection t / t ∧
    ∫ (t : ℝ) in 1 / 16..9 / 16, M.boundaryCorrection t / t ≤ Real.log 9

name: Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData.determinantRatio_energy_ratio
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData ι) {a b : ℝ},
  0 < a →
    a ≤ b →
      M.determinantRatio b / M.determinantRatio a =
        √(M.inverseEnergy b / M.inverseEnergy a) * Real.exp (∫ (t : ℝ) in a..b, M.boundaryCorrection t / t)

name: Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData.determinantRatio_energy_bounds
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData ι) {a b : ℝ},
  0 < a →
    a ≤ b →
      √(M.inverseEnergy b / M.inverseEnergy a) ≤ M.determinantRatio b / M.determinantRatio a ∧
        M.determinantRatio b / M.determinantRatio a ≤ b / a * √(M.inverseEnergy b / M.inverseEnergy a)

name: Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData.fixed_anchor_energy_bounds
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData ι),
  √(M.inverseEnergy (9 / 16) / M.inverseEnergy (1 / 16)) ≤ M.determinantRatio (9 / 16) / M.determinantRatio (1 / 16) ∧
    M.determinantRatio (9 / 16) / M.determinantRatio (1 / 16) ≤
      9 * √(M.inverseEnergy (9 / 16) / M.inverseEnergy (1 / 16))

name: Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData.hasDerivAt_log_determinantRatio
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData ι) {s : ℝ},
  0 < s → HasDerivAt (fun t => Real.log (M.determinantRatio t)) ((M.highMean s - M.freeMean s) / s) s

name: Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData.empty_high_block
type:
∀ {κ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype κ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq κ] [IsEmpty κ] (A B K : Matrix κ κ ℝ) (s : ℝ),
  (K + s • B).det / (B.det * (A + s • 1).det) = 1 ∧ s * ((K + s • B)⁻¹ * B).trace = 0

name: Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData.inversePencil_beta
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData ι) {s : ℝ},
  0 < s → (M.inversePencil s).mulVec M.beta = (M.determinantRatio s)⁻¹ • (M.resolvent s).mulVec (M.B⁻¹.mulVec M.beta)

name: Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData.inversePencil_mass
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData ι) {s : ℝ},
  0 < s →
    M.inversePencil s * M.B =
      M.resolvent s -
        (M.determinantRatio s)⁻¹ •
          Matrix.vecMulVec ((M.resolvent s).mulVec (M.B⁻¹.mulVec M.beta)) (Matrix.vecMul M.zeta (M.resolvent s))

name: Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData.highMean_eq
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData ι) {s : ℝ},
  0 < s → M.highMean s = M.freeMean s + s * deriv M.determinantRatio s / M.determinantRatio s

name: Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData.highMean_inverseEnergy_identity
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (M : Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData ι) {s : ℝ},
  0 < s → M.highMean s = M.freeMean s + M.boundaryCorrection s + s / 2 * deriv (fun t => Real.log (M.inverseEnergy t)) s

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.positiveLatticeWeight
type: ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeTail
type: ℝ → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.imaginary_mem_integerComplement
type: ∀ {t : ℝ}, 0 < t → Complex.I * ↑t ∈ Complex.integerComplement

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.cot_pair_imaginary
type: ∀ {t : ℝ}, 0 < t → ∀ (n : ℕ), Complex.I * ↑t / 2 * cotTerm (Complex.I * ↑t) n = ↑(t ^ 2 / (t ^ 2 + (↑n + 1) ^ 2))

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.summable_dimensionless_lattice
type: ∀ {t : ℝ}, 0 < t → Summable fun n => t ^ 2 / (t ^ 2 + (↑n + 1) ^ 2)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.dimensionless_lattice_eq_cot
type:
∀ {t : ℝ},
  0 < t →
    ↑(∑' (n : ℕ), t ^ 2 / (t ^ 2 + (↑n + 1) ^ 2)) =
      (↑Real.pi * (Complex.I * ↑t) * (↑Real.pi * (Complex.I * ↑t)).cot - 1) / 2

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.positiveLatticeWeight_nonneg
type: ∀ (L : ℝ) {s : ℝ}, 0 ≤ s → ∀ (j : ℕ), 0 ≤ Riemann.CCM.Native.positiveLatticeWeight L s j

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeTail_nonneg
type: ∀ (L : ℝ) (N : ℕ) {s : ℝ}, 0 ≤ s → 0 ≤ Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeTail L N s

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.positiveLatticeWeight_dimensionless
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (a : ℝ) (j : ℕ),
      Riemann.CCM.Native.positiveLatticeWeight L (a ^ 2) j =
        (a / (2 * Real.pi / L)) ^ 2 / ((a / (2 * Real.pi / L)) ^ 2 + ↑j ^ 2)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.summable_positiveLatticeWeight
type: ∀ {L a : ℝ}, 0 < L → 0 < a → Summable fun n => Riemann.CCM.Native.positiveLatticeWeight L (a ^ 2) (n + 1)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.summable_latticeTail
type: ∀ {L a : ℝ}, 0 < L → 0 < a → ∀ (N : ℕ), Summable fun k => Riemann.CCM.Native.positiveLatticeWeight L (a ^ 2) (N + k + 1)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeTail_split
type:
∀ {L a : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    0 < a →
      ∀ (N : ℕ),
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, Riemann.CCM.Native.positiveLatticeWeight L (a ^ 2) (j + 1) +
            Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeTail L N (a ^ 2) =
          Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeTail L 0 (a ^ 2)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeTail_zero_eq_cot
type:
∀ {L a : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    0 < a →
      ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeTail L 0 (a ^ 2)) =
        (↑L * (Complex.I * ↑a) / 2 * (↑L * (Complex.I * ↑a) / 2).cot - 1) / 2

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeTail_zero_eq_hyperbolic
type:
∀ {L a : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    0 < a →
      Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeTail L 0 (a ^ 2) = (L * a / 2 * (Real.cosh (L * a / 2) / Real.sinh (L * a / 2)) - 1) / 2

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.positiveLatticeWeight_le_telescoping
type:
∀ {L a : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (N : ℕ),
      0 < N →
        ∀ (k : ℕ),
          Riemann.CCM.Native.positiveLatticeWeight L (a ^ 2) (N + k + 1) ≤
            (a / (2 * Real.pi / L)) ^ 2 * (1 / (↑N + ↑k) - 1 / (↑N + ↑k + 1))

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeTail_le
type:
∀ {L a : ℝ},
  0 < L → ∀ (N : ℕ), 0 < N → Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeTail L N (a ^ 2) ≤ a ^ 2 * L ^ 2 / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2 * ↑N)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeTail_quarter_le
type: ∀ {L : ℝ}, 0 < L → ∀ (N : ℕ), 0 < N → Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeTail L N (1 / 16) ≤ L ^ 2 / (64 * Real.pi ^ 2 * ↑N)

type:

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHigh_displacement
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ),
  0 < L →
    ∀ (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C) (J : ℕ),
      Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighEnergy C L A J =
        Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighMass C A J ∘SL Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighFree L J +

              ((Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighProjection N J) (Riemann.CCM.Native.displacementVector C L)))

type:

type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).shifted ∘SL (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).corrected =
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).corrected ∘SL
      (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).shifted

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_corrected_eigenvalue_real
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  {x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N} {z : ℂ},
  x ≠ 0 → (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).corrected x = z • x → z.im = 0

type:

  Riemann.CCM.Native.ofMatrix (Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryMatrix L v) =
    Riemann.CCM.Native.derivative L -
      ((InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ) ((Riemann.CCM.Native.derivative L) v)) (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpointVector N L)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_boundaryMatrix_operator
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C),
  Riemann.CCM.Native.ofMatrix
      (Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryMatrix L (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).groundVector) =
    (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).corrected

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_determinant_ratio
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (z : ℂ),
  (∀ (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N), z ≠ ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i)) →
    (Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryMatrix L (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).groundVector - z • 1).det /
        (Riemann.CCM.Native.freeMatrix N L - z • 1).det =
      -z *
        ((↑√L)⁻¹ *
          ∑ i, (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).groundVector.ofLp i / (↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i) - z))

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_boundary_det_ne_zero
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  {z : ℂ},
  z.im ≠ 0 → (Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryMatrix L (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).groundVector - z • 1).det ≠ 0

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.oddGraphData
type:
{E : Type u_1} →
  {U : Type u_2} →
    {W : Type u_3} →
      [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] →
        [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] →
          [FiniteDimensional ℂ E] →
            [inst_3 : CompleteSpace E] →
              [inst_4 : NormedAddCommGroup U] →
                [inst_5 : InnerProductSpace ℂ U] →
                  [inst_6 : FiniteDimensional ℂ U] →
                    [inst_7 : NormedAddCommGroup W] →
                      [inst_8 : InnerProductSpace ℂ W] →
                        [inst_9 : FiniteDimensional ℂ W] →
                          (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E) →
                            (Z : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U W →L[ℂ] E) →
                              Function.Injective ⇑Z →
                                (∀ (x : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U W), M.reflection (Z x) = -Z x) →
                                  (A₁ : U →L[ℂ] U) →
                                    (A₂ : W →L[ℂ] W) →
                                      (∀ (x : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U W),
                                          M.D (M.D (Z x)) = Z ((Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.block A₁ 0 A₂) x)) →
                                        Riemann.Capacity.GraphData U W

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.oddGraphData_metric
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {U : Type u_2} {W : Type u_3} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_4 : NormedAddCommGroup U]
  [inst_5 : InnerProductSpace ℂ U] [inst_6 : FiniteDimensional ℂ U] [inst_7 : NormedAddCommGroup W]
  [inst_8 : InnerProductSpace ℂ W] [inst_9 : FiniteDimensional ℂ W] (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E)
  (Z : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U W →L[ℂ] E) (hZ : Function.Injective ⇑Z)
  (hodd : ∀ (x : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U W), M.reflection (Z x) = -Z x) (A₁ : U →L[ℂ] U) (A₂ : W →L[ℂ] W)
  (hfree :
    ∀ (x : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U W), M.D (M.D (Z x)) = Z ((Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.block A₁ 0 A₂) x)),
  (M.oddGraphData Z hZ hodd A₁ A₂ hfree).fullMetric = Riemann.Capacity.columnEnergy M.shifted Z

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.oddGraphData_coupling_bounds
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {U : Type u_2} {W : Type u_3} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_4 : NormedAddCommGroup U]
  [inst_5 : InnerProductSpace ℂ U] [inst_6 : FiniteDimensional ℂ U] [inst_7 : NormedAddCommGroup W]
  [inst_8 : InnerProductSpace ℂ W] [inst_9 : FiniteDimensional ℂ W] (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E)
  (Z : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U W →L[ℂ] E) (hZ : Function.Injective ⇑Z)
  (hodd : ∀ (x : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U W), M.reflection (Z x) = -Z x) (A₁ : U →L[ℂ] U) (A₂ : W →L[ℂ] W)
  (hfree :
    ∀ (x : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U W), M.D (M.D (Z x)) = Z ((Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.block A₁ 0 A₂) x))
  (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s),
  0 ≤ (M.oddGraphData Z hZ hodd A₁ A₂ hfree).coupling s hs ∧ (M.oddGraphData Z hZ hodd A₁ A₂ hfree).coupling s hs < 1

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.oddGraphData_fullPencil
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {U : Type u_2} {W : Type u_3} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_4 : NormedAddCommGroup U]
  [inst_5 : InnerProductSpace ℂ U] [inst_6 : FiniteDimensional ℂ U] [inst_7 : NormedAddCommGroup W]
  [inst_8 : InnerProductSpace ℂ W] [inst_9 : FiniteDimensional ℂ W] (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E)
  (Z : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U W →L[ℂ] E) (hZ : Function.Injective ⇑Z)
  (hodd : ∀ (x : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U W), M.reflection (Z x) = -Z x) (A₁ : U →L[ℂ] U) (A₂ : W →L[ℂ] W)
  (hfree :
    ∀ (x : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U W), M.D (M.D (Z x)) = Z ((Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.block A₁ 0 A₂) x)),
  (M.oddGraphData Z hZ hodd A₁ A₂ hfree).fullPencil = M.oddColumnPencil Z hZ hodd

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.oddGraphData_mean_bounds
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {U : Type u_2} {W : Type u_3} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_4 : NormedAddCommGroup U]
  [inst_5 : InnerProductSpace ℂ U] [inst_6 : FiniteDimensional ℂ U] [inst_7 : NormedAddCommGroup W]
  [inst_8 : InnerProductSpace ℂ W] [inst_9 : FiniteDimensional ℂ W] (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E)
  (Z : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U W →L[ℂ] E) (hZ : Function.Injective ⇑Z)
  (hodd : ∀ (x : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U W), M.reflection (Z x) = -Z x) (A₁ : U →L[ℂ] U) (A₂ : W →L[ℂ] W)
  (hfree :
    ∀ (x : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space U W), M.D (M.D (Z x)) = Z ((Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.block A₁ 0 A₂) x))
  (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s),
  (M.oddGraphData Z hZ hodd A₁ A₂ hfree).highPencil.softMean s hs +
        (M.oddGraphData Z hZ hodd A₁ A₂ hfree).graphPencil.softMean s hs ≤
      (M.oddColumnPencil Z hZ hodd).softMean s hs ∧
    (M.oddColumnPencil Z hZ hodd).softMean s hs <
      (M.oddGraphData Z hZ hodd A₁ A₂ hfree).highPencil.softMean s hs +
          (M.oddGraphData Z hZ hodd A₁ A₂ hfree).graphPencil.softMean s hs +
        1

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highMatrixOperator_mul
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (A B : Matrix (Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J) (Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J) ℂ),
  Riemann.CCM.Native.highMatrixOperator (A * B) =
    Riemann.CCM.Native.highMatrixOperator A ∘SL Riemann.CCM.Native.highMatrixOperator B

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highMatrixOperator_one
type: ∀ {N J : ℕ}, Riemann.CCM.Native.highMatrixOperator 1 = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ (Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv_pencil
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (s : ℝ) (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv N J).symm
      (((Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighPencil C L hL A J).pencil s) ((Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv N J) x)) =
    (Riemann.CCM.Native.highMatrixOperator
        ((Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealEnergy C L hL A J + s • Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealMass C L hL A J).map
          Complex.ofReal))
      x

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv_inverse
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv N J).symm
      ((Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse ((Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighPencil C L hL A J).pencil s) ⋯)
        ((Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv N J) x)) =
    (Riemann.CCM.Native.highMatrixOperator
        ((Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealEnergy C L hL A J + s • Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealMass C L hL A J)⁻¹.map
          Complex.ofReal))
      x

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv_inverseMass
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv N J).symm
      ((Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse ((Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighPencil C L hL A J).pencil s) ⋯)
        ((Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighMass C A J) ((Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv N J) x))) =
    (Riemann.CCM.Native.highMatrixOperator
        (((Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealEnergy C L hL A J + s • Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealMass C L hL A J)⁻¹ *
              Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealMass C L hL A J).map
          Complex.ofReal))
      x

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHigh_inverseMassTrace
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s),
  Riemann.Capacity.inverseMassTrace ((Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighPencil C L hL A J).pencil s) ⋯
      (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighMass C A J) =
    ↑((Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealEnergy C L hL A J + s • Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealMass C L hL A J)⁻¹ *
          Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealMass C L hL A J).trace

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHigh_softMean_eq
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (J : ℕ) (hJN : J < N) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighPencil C L hL A J).softMean s hs =
    (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeInverseEnergyData C L hL A J hJN).highMean s

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinate_det_eq
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (T : ↥(Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighSection N J) →L[ℂ] ↥(Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighSection N J))
  (R : Matrix (Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J) (Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J) ℝ),
  (∀ (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J),
      (Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv N J).symm (T ((Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv N J) x)) =
        (Riemann.CCM.Native.highMatrixOperator (R.map Complex.ofReal)) x) →
    LinearMap.det ↑T = ↑R.det

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHigh_pencil_det
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (s : ℝ),
  LinearMap.det ↑((Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighPencil C L hL A J).pencil s) =
    ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealEnergy C L hL A J + s • Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealMass C L hL A J).det

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHigh_mass_det
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C),
  LinearMap.det ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighMass C A J) = ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealMass C L hL A J).det

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv_freePencil
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (L s : ℝ) (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv N J).symm
      ((Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighFree L J + ↑s • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ↥(Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighSection N J))
        ((Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv N J) x)) =
    (Riemann.CCM.Native.highMatrixOperator ((Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealFree L N J + s • 1).map Complex.ofReal)) x

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHigh_freePencil_det
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (L s : ℝ),
  LinearMap.det
      ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighFree L J + ↑s • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ↥(Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighSection N J)) =
    ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealFree L N J + s • 1).det

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHigh_determinantRatio_eq
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (J : ℕ) (hJN : J < N) (s : ℝ),
  LinearMap.det ↑((Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighPencil C L hL A J).pencil s) /
      (LinearMap.det ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighMass C A J) *
        LinearMap.det
          ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighFree L J +
              ↑s • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ↥(Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighSection N J))) =
    ↑((Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeInverseEnergyData C L hL A J hJN).determinantRatio s)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv_realSynthesis
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J → ℝ),
  ↑((Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv N J) (WithLp.toLp 2 fun j => ↑(x j))) =
    Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighRealSynthesis x

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv_realForm
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J),
  (∀ (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N), ((↑((Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv N J) x)).ofLp i).im = 0) ↔
    ∀ (j : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J), (x.ofLp j).im = 0

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates
type: ℕ → ℕ → Type

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highSynthesisLinear
type: (N J : ℕ) → Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J →ₗ[ℂ] Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N

type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.highSynthesisLinear N J) x = ∑ j, x.ofLp j • Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector j

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highSynthesisLinear_single
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (j : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.highSynthesisLinear N J) (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) = Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector j

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highSynthesisIsometry
type: (N J : ℕ) → Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J →ₗᵢ[ℂ] Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highSynthesisIsometry_apply
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.highSynthesisIsometry N J) x = ∑ j, x.ofLp j • Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector j

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector_mem
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (j : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J),
  Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector j ∈ Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighSection N J

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highSynthesis_mem
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.highSynthesisIsometry N J) x ∈ Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighSection N J

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highSynthesis
type: (N J : ℕ) → Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J →ₗᵢ[ℂ] ↥(Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighSection N J)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highSynthesis_coe
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J),
  ↑((Riemann.CCM.Native.highSynthesis N J) x) = ∑ j, x.ofLp j • Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector j

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highSynthesis_positive
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J) (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J),
  (↑((Riemann.CCM.Native.highSynthesis N J) x)).ofLp (Riemann.CCM.Native.highPositiveIndex i) = x.ofLp i * (↑√2)⁻¹

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.odd_high_ext
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} {x y : ↥(Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighSection N J)},
  (∀ (j : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J),
      (↑x).ofLp (Riemann.CCM.Native.highPositiveIndex j) = (↑y).ofLp (Riemann.CCM.Native.highPositiveIndex j)) →
    x = y

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highSynthesis_surjective
type: ∀ (N J : ℕ), Function.Surjective ⇑(Riemann.CCM.Native.highSynthesis N J)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv
type: (N J : ℕ) → Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] ↥(Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighSection N J)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv_apply
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J),
  ↑((Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv N J) x) = ∑ j, x.ofLp j • Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector j

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv_single
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (j : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J),
  ↑((Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv N J) (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) = Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector j

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv_symm_inner
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (x : ↥(Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighSection N J)) (j : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J),
  ((Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv N J).symm x).ofLp j =
    inner ℂ ((Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv N J) (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) x

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv_symm_apply
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (x : ↥(Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighSection N J)) (j : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J),
  ((Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv N J).symm x).ofLp j = inner ℂ (Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector j) ↑x

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highMatrixOperator
type:
{N J : ℕ} →
  Matrix (Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J) (Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J) ℂ →
    Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J →L[ℂ] Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highMatrixOperator_apply
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J) (Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J) ℂ)
  (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J) (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J),
  ((Riemann.CCM.Native.highMatrixOperator A) x).ofLp i = ∑ j, A i j * x.ofLp j

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv_free
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (L : ℝ) (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighFree L J) ((Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv N J) x) =
    (Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv N J)
      ((Riemann.CCM.Native.highMatrixOperator ((Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealFree L N J).map Complex.ofReal)) x)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinate_conjugate_apply
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (T : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N →L[ℂ] Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N)
  (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J) (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J),
  ((Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv N J).symm
          ((Riemann.Capacity.columnEnergy T (Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighInclusion N J))
            ((Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv N J) x))).ofLp
      i =
    ∑ j, inner ℂ (Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector i) (T (Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector j)) * x.ofLp j

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv_mass
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv N J).symm
      ((Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighMass C A J) ((Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv N J) x)) =
    (Riemann.CCM.Native.highMatrixOperator ((Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealMass C L hL A J).map Complex.ofReal)) x

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv_energy
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv N J).symm
      ((Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighEnergy C L A J) ((Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv N J) x)) =
    (Riemann.CCM.Native.highMatrixOperator ((Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealEnergy C L hL A J).map Complex.ofReal)) x

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.lowHighMerge
type:
(N J : ℕ) →
  Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space (Riemann.CCM.Native.LowCoordinates N J)
      (Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]
    Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N 0

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.lowHighMerge_apply
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ}
  (x :
    Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space (Riemann.CCM.Native.LowCoordinates N J) (Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J))
  (j : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N 0),
  ((Riemann.CCM.Native.lowHighMerge N J) x).ofLp j =
    if h : ↑↑j ≤ J then (WithLp.fst x).ofLp ⟨↑j, ⋯⟩ else (WithLp.snd x).ofLp ⟨↑j, ⋯⟩

(N J : ℕ) →

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeLowHighColumns
type:
(N J : ℕ) →

    Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeLowHighColumns_injective
type: ∀ (N J : ℕ), Function.Injective ⇑(Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeLowHighColumns N J)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeLowHighColumns_odd
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ}
  (x :
    Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space (Riemann.CCM.Native.LowCoordinates N J) (Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J)),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.reflection N) ((Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeLowHighColumns N J) x) =
    -(Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeLowHighColumns N J) x

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeLowHighColumns_range
type: ∀ (N J : ℕ), Set.range ⇑(Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeLowHighColumns N J) = ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighSection N 0)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeLowHighColumns_isometry
type: ∀ (N J : ℕ), Isometry ⇑(Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeLowHighColumns N J)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.lowFreeOperator
type: ℝ → (N J : ℕ) → Riemann.CCM.Native.LowCoordinates N J →L[ℂ] Riemann.CCM.Native.LowCoordinates N J

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.lowFreeOperator_apply
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (L : ℝ) (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.LowCoordinates N J) (j : Riemann.CCM.Native.LowIndex N J),
  ((Riemann.CCM.Native.lowFreeOperator L N J) x).ofLp j = ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.highFrequency L ⟨↑j, ⋯⟩ ^ 2) * x.ofLp j

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highFreeOperator_apply
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (L : ℝ) (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J) (j : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J),
  ((Riemann.CCM.Native.highMatrixOperator ((Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealFree L N J).map Complex.ofReal)) x).ofLp j =
    ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.highFrequency L j ^ 2) * x.ofLp j

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.lowHighMerge_free
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (L : ℝ)
  (x :
    Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space (Riemann.CCM.Native.LowCoordinates N J) (Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J)),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.highMatrixOperator ((Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealFree L N 0).map Complex.ofReal))
      ((Riemann.CCM.Native.lowHighMerge N J) x) =
    (Riemann.CCM.Native.lowHighMerge N J)
      ((Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.block (Riemann.CCM.Native.lowFreeOperator L N J) 0
          (Riemann.CCM.Native.highMatrixOperator ((Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealFree L N J).map Complex.ofReal)))
        x)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeLowHighColumns_free
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (L : ℝ)
  (x :
    Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space (Riemann.CCM.Native.LowCoordinates N J) (Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J)),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.derivative L)
      ((Riemann.CCM.Native.derivative L) ((Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeLowHighColumns N J) x)) =
    (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeLowHighColumns N J)
      ((Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.block (Riemann.CCM.Native.lowFreeOperator L N J) 0
          (Riemann.CCM.Native.highMatrixOperator ((Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealFree L N J).map Complex.ofReal)))
        x)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.canonicalNativeGraphData
type:
{N : ℕ} →
  (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) →
    (L : ℝ) →
      0 < L →
        Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C →
          (J : ℕ) →
            Riemann.Capacity.GraphData (Riemann.CCM.Native.LowCoordinates N J) (Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.canonicalNativeGraphData_fullPencil
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (J : ℕ),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.canonicalNativeGraphData C L hL A J).fullPencil =
    (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighPencil C L hL A 0).congruence ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeLowHighEquiv N J)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.canonicalNativeGraphData_fullMean
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (J : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.canonicalNativeGraphData C L hL A J).fullPencil.softMean s hs =
    (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighPencil C L hL A 0).softMean s hs

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.canonicalNativeGraphData_fullMean_real
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (J : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.canonicalNativeGraphData C L hL A J).fullPencil.softMean s hs =
    (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeInverseEnergyData C L hL A 0 hN).highMean s

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.lowHighMerge_inl
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ}
  (x :
    Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space (Riemann.CCM.Native.LowCoordinates N J) (Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J))
  (j : Riemann.CCM.Native.LowIndex N J),
  ((Riemann.CCM.Native.lowHighMerge N J) x).ofLp ((Riemann.CCM.Native.lowHighIndexEquiv N J) (Sum.inl j)) =
    (WithLp.fst x).ofLp j

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.lowHighMerge_inr
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ}
  (x :
    Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space (Riemann.CCM.Native.LowCoordinates N J) (Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J))
  (j : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J),
  ((Riemann.CCM.Native.lowHighMerge N J) x).ofLp ((Riemann.CCM.Native.lowHighIndexEquiv N J) (Sum.inr j)) =
    (WithLp.snd x).ofLp j

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeLowHighColumns_sum
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ}
  (x :
    Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space (Riemann.CCM.Native.LowCoordinates N J) (Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J)),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeLowHighColumns N J) x =
    ∑ j, (WithLp.fst x).ofLp j • Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector ⟨↑j, ⋯⟩ +
      ∑ j, (WithLp.snd x).ofLp j • Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector j

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeLowHighColumns_high
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeLowHighColumns N J) (Riemann.Capacity.highIncl x) =
    ↑((Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv N J) x)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.canonicalNativeGraphData_highPencil
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (J : ℕ),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.canonicalNativeGraphData C L hL A J).highPencil =

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.canonicalNativeGraphData_highMean
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (J : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s),

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.canonicalNativeGraphData_highMean_real
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (J : ℕ) (hJN : J < N) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s),

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highPositiveIndex
type: {N J : ℕ} → Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J → Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.mode_highPositiveIndex
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (j : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J),
  Riemann.CCM.Native.mode (Riemann.CCM.Native.highPositiveIndex j) = ↑↑↑j

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highPositiveIndex_injective
type: ∀ {N J : ℕ}, Function.Injective Riemann.CCM.Native.highPositiveIndex

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highPositiveIndex_ne_rev
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (i j : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J),
  Riemann.CCM.Native.highPositiveIndex i ≠ Fin.rev (Riemann.CCM.Native.highPositiveIndex j)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector
type: {N J : ℕ} → Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J → Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector_apply
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (j : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J) (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector j).ofLp i =
    (↑√2)⁻¹ *
      ((if i = Riemann.CCM.Native.highPositiveIndex j then 1 else 0) -
        if i = Fin.rev (Riemann.CCM.Native.highPositiveIndex j) then 1 else 0)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector_positive
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (i j : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector j).ofLp (Riemann.CCM.Native.highPositiveIndex i) = if i = j then (↑√2)⁻¹ else 0

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector_odd
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (j : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.reflection N) (Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector j) = -Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector j

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highFrequency
type: {N J : ℕ} → ℝ → Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J → ℝ

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highFrequency_pos
type: ∀ {N J : ℕ} {L : ℝ}, 0 < L → ∀ (j : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J), 0 < Riemann.CCM.Native.highFrequency L j

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector_squaredDerivative
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (L : ℝ) (j : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.derivative L) ((Riemann.CCM.Native.derivative L) (Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector j)) =
    Riemann.CCM.Native.highFrequency L j ^ 2 • Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector j

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighRealSynthesis
type: {N J : ℕ} → (Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J → ℝ) → Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighRealSynthesis_positive
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J → ℝ) (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighRealSynthesis x).ofLp (Riemann.CCM.Native.highPositiveIndex i) = ↑(x i) * (↑√2)⁻¹

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighRealSynthesis_injective
type: ∀ {N J : ℕ}, Function.Injective Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighRealSynthesis

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighRealSynthesis_odd
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J → ℝ),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.reflection N) (Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighRealSynthesis x) =
    -Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighRealSynthesis x

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.realColumnGram
type:
{N J : ℕ} →
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N →L[ℂ] Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N) →
    (Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J → Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N) →
      Matrix (Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J) (Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J) ℝ

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.realColumnGram_symmetric
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (T : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N →L[ℂ] Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
  ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T = T →
    ∀ (w : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J → Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
      (Riemann.CCM.Native.realColumnGram T w).IsHermitian

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.realColumnGram_quadratic
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (T : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N →L[ℂ] Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N)
  (w : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J → Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N) (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J → ℝ),
  x ⬝ᵥ (Riemann.CCM.Native.realColumnGram T w).mulVec x = (inner ℂ (∑ i, ↑(x i) • w i) (T (∑ j, ↑(x j) • w j))).re

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector_inner
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (j : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J) (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
  inner ℂ (Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector j) x =
    (↑√2)⁻¹ *
      (x.ofLp (Riemann.CCM.Native.highPositiveIndex j) - x.ofLp (Fin.rev (Riemann.CCM.Native.highPositiveIndex j)))

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector_negative
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (i j : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector j).ofLp (Fin.rev (Riemann.CCM.Native.highPositiveIndex i)) =
    -if i = j then (↑√2)⁻¹ else 0

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector_orthonormal
type: ∀ {N J : ℕ}, Orthonormal ℂ Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector_real
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (j : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J) (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
  ((Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector j).ofLp i).im = 0

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.derivative_real
type:

  (∀ (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N), (x.ofLp i).im = 0) →
    ∀ (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N), (((Riemann.CCM.Native.derivative L) x).ofLp i).im = 0

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.shifted_real
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
  (∀ (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N), (x.ofLp i).im = 0) →
    ∀ (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N), (((Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).shifted x).ofLp i).im = 0

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.inner_real_of_coordinates
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (x y : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
  (∀ (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N), (x.ofLp i).im = 0) →
    (∀ (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N), (y.ofLp i).im = 0) → (inner ℂ x y).im = 0

type: {N J : ℕ} → ℝ → Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J → ℝ

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealZeta_pos
type: ∀ {N J : ℕ} {L : ℝ}, 0 < L → ∀ (j : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J), 0 < Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealZeta L j

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector_zeta_pairing
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (L : ℝ) (j : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J),
  inner ℂ (Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector j)
      ((Riemann.CCM.Native.derivative L) (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpointVector N L)) =

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector_endpointDerivative
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (L : ℝ) (j : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J),
  inner ℂ (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpointVector N L)
      ((Riemann.CCM.Native.derivative L) (Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector j)) =

          (J : ℕ) → Matrix (Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J) (Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J) ℝ

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealFree
type: ℝ → (N J : ℕ) → Matrix (Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J) (Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J) ℝ

type: {N J : ℕ} → Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N → ℝ → Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J → ℝ

type: ∀ {N J : ℕ} {L : ℝ}, 0 < L → (Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealFree L N J).PosDef

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealMass_pos
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (J : ℕ), (Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealMass C L hL A J).PosDef

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealEnergy_pos
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (J : ℕ), (Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealEnergy C L hL A J).PosDef

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealBeta_complex_entry
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (j : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J),
  ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealBeta C L j) =
    inner ℂ (Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector j) (Riemann.CCM.Native.displacementVector C L)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highReal_displacement
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (J : ℕ),
  Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealEnergy C L hL A J =
    Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealMass C L hL A J * Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealFree L N J +
      Matrix.of fun i j => Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealBeta C L i * Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealZeta L j

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealMass_complex_entry
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (i j : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J),
  ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealMass C L hL A J i j) =
    inner ℂ (Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector i)
      ((Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).shifted (Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector j))

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealEnergy_complex_entry
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (i j : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J),
  ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealEnergy C L hL A J i j) =
    inner ℂ ((Riemann.CCM.Native.derivative L) (Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector i))
      ((Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).shifted
        ((Riemann.CCM.Native.derivative L) (Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighVector j)))

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealZeta_ne_zero
type: ∀ {N J : ℕ} {L : ℝ}, 0 < L → J < N → Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealZeta L ≠ 0

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeInverseEnergyData
type:
{N : ℕ} →
  (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) →
    (L : ℝ) →
      0 < L →
        Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C →
          (J : ℕ) → J < N → Riemann.CCM.InverseEnergyData (Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_highMean_inverseEnergy_identity
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (J : ℕ) (hJN : J < N) {s : ℝ},
  0 < s →
    have M := Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeInverseEnergyData C L hL A J hJN;
    M.highMean s = M.freeMean s + M.boundaryCorrection s + s / 2 * deriv (fun t => Real.log (M.inverseEnergy t)) s

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_fixed_anchor_log_identity
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (J : ℕ) (hJN : J < N),
  have M := Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeInverseEnergyData C L hL A J hJN;
  Real.log (M.determinantRatio (9 / 16) / M.determinantRatio (1 / 16)) =
    1 / 2 * Real.log (M.inverseEnergy (9 / 16) / M.inverseEnergy (1 / 16)) +
      ∫ (t : ℝ) in 1 / 16..9 / 16, M.boundaryCorrection t / t

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_fixed_anchor_capacity_energy_bounds
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (J : ℕ) (hJN : J < N),
  have M := Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeInverseEnergyData C L hL A J hJN;
  Real.log 9 * (M.highMean (1 / 16) - 1) ≤
      M.freeLogRatio (1 / 16) (9 / 16) + 1 / 2 * Real.log (M.inverseEnergy (9 / 16) / M.inverseEnergy (1 / 16)) ∧
    M.freeLogRatio (1 / 16) (9 / 16) + 1 / 2 * Real.log (M.inverseEnergy (9 / 16) / M.inverseEnergy (1 / 16)) ≤
      8 * M.highMean (1 / 16)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.fullHighIndexEquiv
type: (N : ℕ) → Fin N ≃ Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N 0

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_freeMean_eq_positive_sum
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (J : ℕ) (hJN : J < N) (s : ℝ),
  0 < s →
    (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeInverseEnergyData C L hL A J hJN).freeMean s =
      ∑ j, Riemann.CCM.Native.positiveLatticeWeight L s ↑↑j

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_full_freeMean_eq_retained
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (hN : 0 < N) (s : ℝ),
  0 < s →
    (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeInverseEnergyData C L hL A 0 hN).freeMean s =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, Riemann.CCM.Native.positiveLatticeWeight L s (j + 1)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_freeMean_tail_cancellation
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (hN : 0 < N) {a : ℝ},
  0 < a →
    -(Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeInverseEnergyData C L hL A 0 hN).freeMean (a ^ 2) +
        Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeTail L 0 (a ^ 2) =
      Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeTail L N (a ^ 2)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_boundarySoftMean_eq_highMean_add_lattice
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (hN : 0 < N) {a : ℝ},
  0 < a →
    Riemann.CCM.Native.boundarySoftMean L (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).groundVector a =
      ↑((Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeInverseEnergyData C L hL A 0 hN).highMean (a ^ 2) +
          Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeTail L N (a ^ 2))

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.realHighCoordinates
type: {N J : ℕ} → (Riemann.CCM.Native.HighIndex N J → ℝ) → Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highMatrixOperator_real

  (Riemann.CCM.Native.highMatrixOperator (R.map Complex.ofReal)) (Riemann.CCM.Native.realHighCoordinates t) =
    Riemann.CCM.Native.realHighCoordinates (R.mulVec t)

type: ℝ → (N J : ℕ) → ↥(Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighSection N J)

  (Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv N J).symm (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighSource L N J) =
    Riemann.CCM.Native.realHighCoordinates (Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealZeta L)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv_massInverse
type:
∀ {N J : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.HighCoordinates N J),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv N J).symm
      ((Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighMass C A J) ⋯)
        ((Riemann.CCM.Native.highCoordinateEquiv N J) x)) =
    (Riemann.CCM.Native.highMatrixOperator ((Riemann.CCM.Native.highRealMass C L hL A J)⁻¹.map Complex.ofReal)) x

∀ (L : ℝ),
  0 < L →
    ∀ (N J : ℕ) {s : ℝ},
      0 < s →
        (Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighFree L J + ↑s • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ↥(Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighSection N J))
            (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighSourceResponse L N J s) =
          Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighSource L N J

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighSourceResponse_unique
type:
∀ (L : ℝ),
  0 < L →
    ∀ (N J : ℕ) {s : ℝ},
      0 < s →
        ∀ (x : ↥(Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighSection N J)),
          (Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighFree L J + ↑s • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ↥(Riemann.CCM.Native.oddHighSection N J))
                x =
              Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighSource L N J →
            x = Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighSourceResponse L N J s

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHigh_sourceEnergy_eq
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (J : ℕ) (hJN : J < N) (s : ℝ),
  Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighSourceEnergy C L hL A J s =
    (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeInverseEnergyData C L hL A J hJN).inverseEnergy s

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHigh_sourceEnergy_pos
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C),
  ∀ J < N, ∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighSourceEnergy C L hL A J s

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHigh_softMean_sourceEnergy_identity
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (J : ℕ) (hJN : J < N) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighPencil C L hL A J).softMean s hs =
    (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeInverseEnergyData C L hL A J hJN).freeMean s +
        (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeInverseEnergyData C L hL A J hJN).boundaryCorrection s +
      s / 2 * deriv (fun t => Real.log (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighSourceEnergy C L hL A J t)) s

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHigh_fixed_anchor_capacity_energy_bounds
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (J : ℕ) (hJN : J < N),
  Real.log 9 * ((Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighPencil C L hL A J).softMean (1 / 16) ⋯ - 1) ≤
      (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeInverseEnergyData C L hL A J hJN).freeLogRatio (1 / 16) (9 / 16) +
        1 / 2 *
          Real.log
            (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighSourceEnergy C L hL A J (9 / 16) /
              Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighSourceEnergy C L hL A J (1 / 16)) ∧
    (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeInverseEnergyData C L hL A J hJN).freeLogRatio (1 / 16) (9 / 16) +
        1 / 2 *
          Real.log
            (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighSourceEnergy C L hL A J (9 / 16) /
              Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighSourceEnergy C L hL A J (1 / 16)) ≤
      8 * (Riemann.CCM.Native.nativeHighPencil C L hL A J).softMean (1 / 16) ⋯

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]

  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E) (W : F →L[ℂ] E) (hW : Function.Injective ⇑W)
