name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.oddColumn_softMean_boundaryCorrection
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E) (W : F →L[ℂ] E) (hW : Function.Injective ⇑W)
  (hodd : ∀ (x : F), M.reflection (W x) = -W x) (p : E) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s),
  |(M.oddColumnPencil W hW hodd).softMean s hs - (M.oddCorrectedColumnPencil W hW hodd p).softMean s hs| ≤ 1

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.oddColumn_displacement
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (M : Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E) [inst_6 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E]
  (W : F →L[ℂ] E),
  (∀ (x : F), M.reflection (W x) = -W x) →
    ∀ (A : F →L[ℂ] F),
      (∀ (x : F), M.D (M.D (W x)) = W (A x)) →
        Riemann.Capacity.columnEnergy M.shifted (M.D ∘SL W) =
          Riemann.Capacity.columnEnergy M.shifted W ∘SL A +
            ((InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ) ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint W) M.b))
              ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint W) (M.D M.eta))

type: {N : ℕ} → Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N → Matrix (Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N) (Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N) ℂ

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.mode_difference_ne_zero
type: ∀ {N : ℕ} {i j : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N}, i ≠ j → ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.mode i) - ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.mode j) ≠ 0

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.weilMatrix_symmetric
type:

type: {N : ℕ} → Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N → Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N →L[ℂ] Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.weilOperator_apply
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N) (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
  ((Riemann.CCM.Native.weilOperator C) x).ofLp i = ∑ j, Riemann.CCM.Native.weilMatrix C i j * x.ofLp j

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.displacementVector
type: {N : ℕ} → Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N → ℝ → Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.displacementVector_apply
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.displacementVector C L).ofLp i = ↑(2 * Real.pi / √L * C.beta i)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.displacementVector_odd
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.reflection N) (Riemann.CCM.Native.displacementVector C L) =
    -Riemann.CCM.Native.displacementVector C L

type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (i j : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
  (↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i) - ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L j)) * Riemann.CCM.Native.weilMatrix C i j =
    ↑(2 * Real.pi / L * (C.beta i - C.beta j))

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.displacement_pairing
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
  inner ℂ (Riemann.CCM.Native.displacementVector C L) x = ∑ i, ↑(2 * Real.pi / √L * C.beta i) * x.ofLp i

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_displacement
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
      (Riemann.CCM.Native.derivative L) ((Riemann.CCM.Native.weilOperator C) x) -
          (Riemann.CCM.Native.weilOperator C) ((Riemann.CCM.Native.derivative L) x) =
        inner ℂ (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpointVector N L) x • Riemann.CCM.Native.displacementVector C L -
          inner ℂ (Riemann.CCM.Native.displacementVector C L) x • Riemann.CCM.Native.endpointVector N L

name: Riemann.Capacity.endpointCorrectedColumns_apply
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F]

name: Riemann.Capacity.endpointCorrectedColumns_boundary
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F]

name: Riemann.Capacity.endpointCorrectedColumns_on_hyperplane
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]

  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (G : E →L[ℂ] E) (D : F →L[ℂ] E) (eta p : E),

      (Riemann.Capacity.columnEnergy G D) =
    Riemann.Basic.physicalCompression (Riemann.Basic.vectorHyperplane ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D) eta))
      (Riemann.Capacity.columnEnergy G (Riemann.Capacity.endpointCorrectedColumns D eta p))

              [FiniteDimensional ℂ F] →
                (G : E →L[ℂ] E) →
                  (↑G).IsSymmetric →
                    (∀ (x : E), 0 ≤ (inner ℂ x (G x)).re) →
                      (F →L[ℂ] E) →
                        (B : F →L[ℂ] F) →

name: Riemann.Capacity.softMean_endpointCorrection_le_one
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (G : E →L[ℂ] E) (hG : (↑G).IsSymmetric) (hpos : ∀ (x : E), 0 ≤ (inner ℂ x (G x)).re)
  (D : F →L[ℂ] E) (B : F →L[ℂ] F) (hB : (↑B).IsSymmetric) (hBp : ∀ (x : F), x ≠ 0 → 0 < (inner ℂ x (B x)).re)
  (eta p : E) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s),
  |(Riemann.Capacity.columnPencil G hG hpos D B hB hBp).softMean s hs -
        (Riemann.Capacity.columnPencil G hG hpos (Riemann.Capacity.endpointCorrectedColumns D eta p) B hB hBp).softMean
          s hs| ≤
    1

name: Riemann.Capacity.columnEnergy_boundaryCorrection
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (G : E →L[ℂ] E),
  ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint G = G →
    ∀ (D : F →L[ℂ] E) (eta p : E),
      Riemann.Capacity.columnEnergy G D -
          Riemann.Capacity.columnEnergy G (Riemann.Capacity.endpointCorrectedColumns D eta p) =
        ((InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ)
                ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Riemann.Capacity.endpointCorrectedColumns D eta p)) (G p)))
              ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D) eta) +
            ((InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ) ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D) eta))
              ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Riemann.Capacity.endpointCorrectedColumns D eta p)) (G p)) +
          inner ℂ p (G p) •
            ((InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ) ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D) eta)) ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D) eta)

name: Riemann.Capacity.RankOneBlocks.inverse_normal
type:
∀ {U : Type u_1} {W : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup U] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ U]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ U] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup W] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ W]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ W] (M : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Data U W) (beta : U) (zeta : W),
  M.B = ((InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ) beta) zeta →
    beta ≠ 0 →
      (Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse (Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.block M.A M.B M.C) ⋯)
          (Riemann.Capacity.lowIncl beta) =
        WithLp.toLp 2
          ((↑(Riemann.Capacity.RankOneBlocks.denominator M beta zeta))⁻¹ •
              Riemann.Capacity.RankOneBlocks.lowResponse M beta,
            -↑(Riemann.Capacity.RankOneBlocks.theta M beta / Riemann.Capacity.RankOneBlocks.denominator M beta zeta) •
              Riemann.Capacity.RankOneBlocks.highResponse M zeta)

type:

  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ U] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup W] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ W]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ W] (M : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Data U W) (beta : U) (zeta : W),
  M.B = ((InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ) beta) zeta →
    beta ≠ 0 →
      (inner ℂ (Riemann.Capacity.lowIncl beta)
            ((Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse (Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.block M.A M.B M.C) ⋯)
              (Riemann.Capacity.lowIncl beta))).re =
        Riemann.Capacity.RankOneBlocks.theta M beta / Riemann.Capacity.RankOneBlocks.denominator M beta zeta

name: Riemann.Capacity.RankOneBlocks.inverse_normal_mass
type:
∀ {U : Type u_1} {W : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup U] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ U]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ U] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup W] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ W]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ W] (M : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Data U W) (beta : U) (zeta : W),
  M.B = ((InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ) beta) zeta →
    beta ≠ 0 →
      ∀ (R : U →L[ℂ] U) (T : W →L[ℂ] W),
        (inner ℂ
              ((Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse (Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.block M.A M.B M.C) ⋯)
                (Riemann.Capacity.lowIncl beta))
              ((Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.block R 0 T)
                ((Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse (Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.block M.A M.B M.C) ⋯)
                  (Riemann.Capacity.lowIncl beta)))).re =
          ((inner ℂ (Riemann.Capacity.RankOneBlocks.lowResponse M beta)
                  (R (Riemann.Capacity.RankOneBlocks.lowResponse M beta))).re +
              Riemann.Capacity.RankOneBlocks.theta M beta ^ 2 *
                (inner ℂ (Riemann.Capacity.RankOneBlocks.highResponse M zeta)
                    (T (Riemann.Capacity.RankOneBlocks.highResponse M zeta))).re) /
            Riemann.Capacity.RankOneBlocks.denominator M beta zeta ^ 2

  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ U] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup W] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ W]

  0 < 1 - P.couplingHeight s hs * P.couplingTheta s hs

name: Riemann.Capacity.GraphData.coupling_formula
type:
∀ {U : Type u_1} {W : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup U] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ U]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ U] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup W] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ W]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ W] (P : Riemann.Capacity.GraphData U W) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s),
  P.coupling s hs =
    s * (P.couplingHeight s hs * P.couplingGraphMass s hs + P.couplingTheta s hs * P.couplingHighMass s hs) /
      (1 - P.couplingHeight s hs * P.couplingTheta s hs)

name: Riemann.Capacity.scalar_log_ratio_bounds
type:
∀ {l a b : ℝ},
  0 < l →
    0 < a →
      a ≤ b →
        Real.log (b / a) * (a / (l + a)) ≤ Real.log ((l + b) / (l + a)) ∧
          Real.log ((l + b) / (l + a)) ≤ (b / a - 1) * (a / (l + a))

name: Riemann.Capacity.finite_log_ratio_bounds
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (lambda : ι → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : ι), 0 < lambda i) →
    ∀ {a b : ℝ},
      0 < a →
        a ≤ b →
          Real.log (b / a) * ∑ i, a / (lambda i + a) ≤ ∑ i, Real.log ((lambda i + b) / (lambda i + a)) ∧
            ∑ i, Real.log ((lambda i + b) / (lambda i + a)) ≤ (b / a - 1) * ∑ i, a / (lambda i + a)

name: Riemann.Capacity.inverseMassTrace
type:
{E : Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] →
    [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] →
      [FiniteDimensional ℂ E] → (H : E →L[ℂ] E) → (∀ (x : E), x ≠ 0 → 0 < (inner ℂ x (H x)).re) → (E →L[ℂ] E) → ℂ

name: Riemann.Capacity.inverseMassTrace_hyperplane
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E]
  (H : E →L[ℂ] E) (hH : ∀ (x : E), x ≠ 0 → 0 < (inner ℂ x (H x)).re),
  (↑H).IsSymmetric →
    ∀ (B : E →L[ℂ] E) (eta : E),
      eta ≠ 0 →
        Riemann.Capacity.inverseMassTrace H hH B -
            Riemann.Capacity.inverseMassTrace (Riemann.Basic.physicalCompression (Riemann.Basic.vectorHyperplane eta) H)
              ⋯ (Riemann.Basic.physicalCompression (Riemann.Basic.vectorHyperplane eta) B) =
          inner ℂ ((Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse H hH) eta) (B ((Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse H hH) eta)) /
            inner ℂ eta ((Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse H hH) eta)

name: Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil
type: (E : Type u_2) → [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] → [InnerProductSpace ℂ E] → Type u_2

name: Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil.pencil
type:
{E : Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] → [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] → Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil E → ℝ → E →L[ℂ] E

name: Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil.pencil_apply
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] (P : Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil E)
  (s : ℝ) (x : E), (P.pencil s) x = P.energy x + ↑s • P.mass x

name: Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil.pencil_positive
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] (P : Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil E)
  (s : ℝ), 0 < s → ∀ (x : E), x ≠ 0 → 0 < (inner ℂ x ((P.pencil s) x)).re

name: Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil.pencil_symmetric
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] (P : Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil E)
  (s : ℝ), (↑(P.pencil s)).IsSymmetric

name: Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil.compress
type:
{E : Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] →
    [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] →
      [FiniteDimensional ℂ E] →
        Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil E → (V : Submodule ℂ E) → Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil ↥V

name: Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil.compress_pencil
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E]
  (P : Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil E) (V : Submodule ℂ E) (s : ℝ),
  (P.compress V).pencil s = Riemann.Basic.physicalCompression V (P.pencil s)

name: Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil.softMean
type:
{E : Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] →
    [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] → [FiniteDimensional ℂ E] → Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil E → (s : ℝ) → 0 < s → ℝ

name: Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil.softMean_hyperplane_difference
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E]
  (P : Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil E) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (eta : E),
  eta ≠ 0 →
    P.softMean s hs - (P.compress (Riemann.Basic.vectorHyperplane eta)).softMean s hs =
      s *
          (inner ℂ ((Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse (P.pencil s) ⋯) eta)
              (P.mass ((Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse (P.pencil s) ⋯) eta))).re /
        (inner ℂ eta ((Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse (P.pencil s) ⋯) eta)).re

name: Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil.softMean_hyperplane_bounds
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E]
  (P : Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil E) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (eta : E),
  eta ≠ 0 →
    0 ≤ P.softMean s hs - (P.compress (Riemann.Basic.vectorHyperplane eta)).softMean s hs ∧
      P.softMean s hs - (P.compress (Riemann.Basic.vectorHyperplane eta)).softMean s hs ≤ 1

name: Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil.softMean_hyperplane_lt_one
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E]
  (P : Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil E),
  (∀ (x : E), x ≠ 0 → 0 < (inner ℂ x (P.energy x)).re) →
    ∀ (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (eta : E),
      eta ≠ 0 → P.softMean s hs - (P.compress (Riemann.Basic.vectorHyperplane eta)).softMean s hs < 1

name: Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil.ext
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  {P Q : Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil E}, P.energy = Q.energy → P.mass = Q.mass → P = Q

name: Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil.softMean_common_hyperplane
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E]
  (P Q : Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil E) (eta : E),
  eta ≠ 0 →
    Riemann.Basic.physicalCompression (Riemann.Basic.vectorHyperplane eta) P.energy =
        Riemann.Basic.physicalCompression (Riemann.Basic.vectorHyperplane eta) Q.energy →
      P.mass = Q.mass → ∀ (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s), |P.softMean s hs - Q.softMean s hs| ≤ 1

name: Riemann.Capacity.inverse_mass_congruence
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (H B : E →L[ℂ] E) (hH : ∀ (x : E), x ≠ 0 → 0 < (inner ℂ x (H x)).re) (e : F ≃L[ℂ] E),
  Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse (Riemann.Basic.galerkinGram H ↑e) ⋯ ∘SL Riemann.Basic.galerkinGram B ↑e =
    ↑e.symm ∘SL Riemann.Basic.positiveInverse H hH ∘SL B ∘SL ↑e

name: Riemann.Capacity.inverseMassTrace_congruence
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (H B : E →L[ℂ] E) (hH : ∀ (x : E), x ≠ 0 → 0 < (inner ℂ x (H x)).re) (e : F ≃L[ℂ] E),
  Riemann.Capacity.inverseMassTrace (Riemann.Basic.galerkinGram H ↑e) ⋯ (Riemann.Basic.galerkinGram B ↑e) =
    Riemann.Capacity.inverseMassTrace H hH B

name: Riemann.Capacity.trace_diagonal
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (A : E →L[ℂ] E) (C : F →L[ℂ] F),
  (LinearMap.trace ℂ (Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space E F)) ↑(Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.block A 0 C) =
    (LinearMap.trace ℂ E) ↑A + (LinearMap.trace ℂ F) ↑C

name: Riemann.Capacity.diagonal_apply
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (A : E →L[ℂ] E) (C : F →L[ℂ] F) (z : Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space E F),
  (Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.block A 0 C) z = WithLp.toLp 2 (A (WithLp.fst z), C (WithLp.snd z))

name: Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil.congruence
type:
{E : Type u_1} →
  {F : Type u_2} →
    [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] →
      [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] →
        [FiniteDimensional ℂ E] →
          [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] →
            [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] →
              [FiniteDimensional ℂ F] →
                Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil E → (F ≃L[ℂ] E) → Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil F

name: Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil.congruence_pencil
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (P : Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil E) (e : F ≃L[ℂ] E) (s : ℝ),
  (P.congruence e).pencil s = Riemann.Basic.galerkinGram (P.pencil s) ↑e

name: Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil.softMean_congruence
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (P : Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil E) (e : F ≃L[ℂ] E) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s),
  (P.congruence e).softMean s hs = P.softMean s hs

name: Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil.orthogonalSum
type:
{E : Type u_1} →
  {F : Type u_2} →
    [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] →
      [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] →
        [FiniteDimensional ℂ E] →
          [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] →
            [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] →
              [FiniteDimensional ℂ F] →
                Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil E →
                  Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil F →
                    Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil (Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.Space E F)

name: Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil.orthogonalSum_pencil
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (P : Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil E) (Q : Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil F)
  (s : ℝ), (P.orthogonalSum Q).pencil s = Riemann.Basic.PositiveSchur.block (P.pencil s) 0 (Q.pencil s)

name: Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil.softMean_orthogonalSum
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F]
  [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (P : Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil E) (Q : Riemann.Capacity.PositivePencil F)
  (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s), (P.orthogonalSum Q).softMean s hs = P.softMean s hs + Q.softMean s hs

name: Riemann.Source.gram_injective
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [inst_5 : CompleteSpace F]
  (T : E →L[ℂ] F), Function.Surjective ⇑T → Function.Injective ⇑(T ∘SL ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T)

name: Riemann.Source.gramEquiv
type:
{E : Type u_1} →
  {F : Type u_2} →
    [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] →
      [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] →
        [CompleteSpace E] →
          [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] →
            [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] →
              [CompleteSpace F] → [FiniteDimensional ℂ F] → (T : E →L[ℂ] F) → Function.Surjective ⇑T → F ≃L[ℂ] F

name: Riemann.Source.gramEquiv_apply
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [inst_5 : CompleteSpace F]
  [inst_6 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (T : E →L[ℂ] F) (hT : Function.Surjective ⇑T) (y : F),
  (Riemann.Source.gramEquiv T hT) y = T ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T) y)

name: Riemann.Source.minimumNormMap
type:
{E : Type u_1} →
  {F : Type u_2} →
    [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] →
      [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] →
        [CompleteSpace E] →
          [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] →
            [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] →
              [CompleteSpace F] → [FiniteDimensional ℂ F] → (T : E →L[ℂ] F) → Function.Surjective ⇑T → F →L[ℂ] E

name: Riemann.Source.minimumNormMap_apply
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [inst_5 : CompleteSpace F]
  [inst_6 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (T : E →L[ℂ] F) (hT : Function.Surjective ⇑T) (y : F),
  (Riemann.Source.minimumNormMap T hT) y = (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T) ((Riemann.Source.gramEquiv T hT).symm y)

name: Riemann.Source.observation_minimumNorm
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [inst_5 : CompleteSpace F]
  [inst_6 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (T : E →L[ℂ] F) (hT : Function.Surjective ⇑T) (y : F),
  T ((Riemann.Source.minimumNormMap T hT) y) = y

name: Riemann.Source.minimumNorm_inner_kernel
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [inst_5 : CompleteSpace F]
  [inst_6 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (T : E →L[ℂ] F) (hT : Function.Surjective ⇑T) (y : F) (z : E),
  T z = 0 → inner ℂ ((Riemann.Source.minimumNormMap T hT) y) z = 0

name: Riemann.Source.source_norm_sq_decomposition
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [inst_5 : CompleteSpace F]
  [inst_6 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (T : E →L[ℂ] F) (hT : Function.Surjective ⇑T) (y : F) (x : E),
  T x = y → ‖x‖ ^ 2 = ‖(Riemann.Source.minimumNormMap T hT) y‖ ^ 2 + ‖x - (Riemann.Source.minimumNormMap T hT) y‖ ^ 2

name: Riemann.Source.minimumNorm_le
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [inst_5 : CompleteSpace F]
  [inst_6 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (T : E →L[ℂ] F) (hT : Function.Surjective ⇑T) (y : F) (x : E),
  T x = y → ‖(Riemann.Source.minimumNormMap T hT) y‖ ≤ ‖x‖

name: Riemann.Source.minimumNorm_unique
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [inst_5 : CompleteSpace F]
  [inst_6 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (T : E →L[ℂ] F) (hT : Function.Surjective ⇑T) (y : F) (x : E),
  T x = y → ‖x‖ = ‖(Riemann.Source.minimumNormMap T hT) y‖ → x = (Riemann.Source.minimumNormMap T hT) y

name: Riemann.Source.minimumNorm_energy
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [inst_5 : CompleteSpace F]
  [inst_6 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (T : E →L[ℂ] F) (hT : Function.Surjective ⇑T) (y : F),
  ‖(Riemann.Source.minimumNormMap T hT) y‖ ^ 2 = (inner ℂ y ((Riemann.Source.gramEquiv T hT).symm y)).re

name: Riemann.Source.minimumNorm_error_energy
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [inst_5 : CompleteSpace F]
  [inst_6 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (T : E →L[ℂ] F) (hT : Function.Surjective ⇑T) (y z : F),
  ‖(Riemann.Source.minimumNormMap T hT) y - (Riemann.Source.minimumNormMap T hT) z‖ ^ 2 =
    (inner ℂ (y - z) ((Riemann.Source.gramEquiv T hT).symm (y - z))).re

name: Riemann.Source.minimumNorm_isLeast
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [inst_5 : CompleteSpace F]
  [inst_6 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (T : E →L[ℂ] F) (hT : Function.Surjective ⇑T) (y : F),
  IsLeast {r | ∃ x, T x = y ∧ ‖x‖ ^ 2 = r} (inner ℂ y ((Riemann.Source.gramEquiv T hT).symm y)).re

name: Riemann.Source.minimumNorm_sInf
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℂ F] [inst_5 : CompleteSpace F]
  [inst_6 : FiniteDimensional ℂ F] (T : E →L[ℂ] F) (hT : Function.Surjective ⇑T) (y : F),
  sInf {r | ∃ x, T x = y ∧ ‖x‖ ^ 2 = r} = (inner ℂ y ((Riemann.Source.gramEquiv T hT).symm y)).re
